perks.name: Ace in the Hole
perks.description:
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have:
    - A Visceral or lower rarity add-on. - {Tunable.S07P03.ModifyChestItemSecondAddonChance%}% chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.
When you escape, you keep your add-ons.

perks.name: Adrenaline
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring {Keyword.Exhausted}:
    - You gain {Tunable.S02P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S02P03.HasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S02P03.ExhaustionDuration}s.

perks.name: Aftercare
perks.description:
You and up to {Tunable.S15P02.MaxSurvivors} Survivors see each other's Auras whenever:
    - You unhook them, or they unhook you. - You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.
This effect lasts until you are hooked.

perks.name: Agitation
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
    - You gain {Tunable.K01P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. - Your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K01P03.TerrorRadiusIncreaseSize}m larger.

perks.name: Alert
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer breaks a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damages a Generator:
    - You hear a sound cue. - You see their Aura for {Tunable.S09P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Any Means Necessary
perks.description:
While next to a Dropped Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} for {Tunable.S20P02.ActionTimeRequired}s to reset it.

You see the Auras of Dropped Pallets.

perks.name: Autodidact
perks.description:
You start the trial with {Tunable.S14P03.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.S14P03.MaxToken}, and your good basic healing Skill Checks give {Tunable.S14P03.InitialProgressionPenalty%}% less progress. While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit:
    - Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S14P03.TokensPerSkillCheck} token. - Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, for each Token, you gain {Tunable.S14P03.ProgressionBonusPerToken%}% more progress. - You cannot get great basic Skill Checks.

perks.name: Babysitter
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
    - They gain {Tunable.S18P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S18P01.HasteDuration}s. - They leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S18P01.StealthDuration}s. - They leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S18P01.StealthDuration}s. - You see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S18P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Balanced Landing
perks.description:
Whenever you fall from at least {Tunable.S05P01.RequiredFallHeight}m:
    - You gain {Tunable.S05P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S05P01.HasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S05P01.ExhaustionDuration}s. - Your stagger is {Tunable.S05P01.FallStaggerReduction%}% shorter. - Your Grunts from falling are {Tunable.S05P01.FallGruntReduction%}% quieter.

perks.name: Bamboozle
perks.description:
Whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for Survivors for {Tunable.K12P01.WindowBlockDurations}s.

You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K12P01.WindowVaultSpeed%}% faster.

Only 1 Window can be blocked at a time.

perks.name: Barbecue & Chili
perks.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for {Tunable.K09P02.AuraRevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of all Survivors who are at least {Tunable.K09P02.MinDistanceFromHook}m away from the hooked Survivor.

perks.name: Beast of Prey
perks.description: Whenever you gain Bloodlust, gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K08P01.UndetectableDuration}s.

perks.name: Better Together
perks.description:
While you are repairing a Generator:
    - Other Survivors see that Generator's Aura. - Whenever the Killer downs a Survivor, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.S19P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Bitter Murmur
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealRange}m of it for {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealEndgameDuration}s.

perks.name: Blood Echo
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for {Tunable.K18P02.HemorrhageExhaustionDuration}s, all injured Survivors:
    - Gain {Keyword.Exhausted}. - Gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage}.

perks.name: Bloodhound
perks.description: Pools of Blood are brighter and last {Tunable.K02P02.ExtraTrackDuration}s longer.

perks.name: Blood Pact
perks.description:
While you are not the Obsession:
    - While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras. - Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or they finish healing you, while within {Tunable.S22P02.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both gain {Tunable.S22P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

perks.name: Blood Warden
perks.description:
When an Exit Gate is opened, once per trial, when you hook a Survivor, both Exits are blocked for {Tunable.K10P03.GateBlockDuration}s.

You see the Auras of Survivors within Exit Thresholds.

perks.name: Boil Over
perks.description:
While carried by the Killer:
    - Whenever the Killer falls from at least {Tunable.S13P03.RequiredFallHeight}m, you gain {Tunable.S13P03.FallExtraWiggle%}% of your current wiggle progress. - Your wiggle is {Tunable.S13P03.WiggleIntensity%}% stronger. - Within {Tunable.S13P03.HookAuraBlockRange}m, the Killer cannot see Hook Auras.

perks.name: Bond
perks.description: Within {Tunable.S01P01.AuraRevealDistance}m, you see other Survivors' Auras.

perks.name: Shattered Hope
perks.description:
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem:
    - You see the Auras of all Survivors within its range for {Tunable.SG_Shattered_Hope.AuraRevealDuration}s. - It is destroyed.

perks.name: Borrowed Time
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
    - They retain their unhook {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S08P02.EnduranceExtraDuration}s longer. - They retain their unhook {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S08P02.HasteExtraDuration}s longer.

perks.name: Botany Knowledge
perks.description: You heal {Tunable.S03P02.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Breakdown
perks.description:
Whenever you are unhooked:
    - The Hook breaks, then is repaired after {Tunable.S15P01.HookRespawnTime}s. - You see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S15P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Breakout
perks.description:
Within {Tunable.S20P03.RequiredDistance}m of a carried Survivor:
    - You gain {Tunable.S20P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. - The carried Survivor wiggles {Tunable.S20P03.ExtraWiggle%}% faster.

perks.name: Brutal Strength
perks.description: You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls, and damage Generators {Tunable.K01P02.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Buckle Up
perks.description:
While healing a downed Survivor, you both see the Killer's Aura. Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor or fully recover:
    - The Survivor gains {Tunable.S17P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S17P02.HasteDuration}s. - The Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S17P02.HasteDuration}s.

perks.name: Built to Last
perks.description:
While holding a depleted item, after hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S23P03.RequiredDuration}s, it is recharged to {Tunable.S23P03.InitialRefill%}%.

Each time you recharge an item this way, it recharges {Tunable.S23P03.RefillDiminishing%}% fewer Charges.

perks.name: Calm Spirit
perks.description:
You do not scare Crows or scream.

You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, but {Tunable.S04P02.ActionSpeedReduction%}% slower.

perks.name: Camaraderie
perks.description: While you are struggling on Hook, when another Survivor gets within {Tunable.S18P02.PauseDistance}m, the timer is paused for {Tunable.S18P02.PauseTimer}s.

perks.name: Corrupt Intervention
perks.description: When the trial starts, the {Tunable.K15P01.GeneratorsBlocked} farthest Generators from you are blocked for {Tunable.K15P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s, or until you down a Survivor.

perks.name: Coulrophobia
perks.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius:
    - Heal {Tunable.K12P02.HealPenalty%}% slower. - While healing, basic Skill Checks spin {Tunable.K12P02.SkillCheckSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

perks.name: Cruel Limits
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
    - You see the Auras of all Windows for {Tunable.K17P02.BlockDuration}s. - All Windows are blocked for Survivors for {Tunable.K17P02.BlockDuration}s.

perks.name: Dance With Me
perks.description: Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, medium-vault, or fast-vault, you leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S13P01.Duration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S13P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Dark Sense
perks.description: Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.AuraRevealDistance}m of you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Dark Devotion
perks.description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, for {Tunable.K15P03.TerrorRadiusTransferDuration}s:
    - Your Terror Radius is set to {Tunable.K15P03.TerrorRadiusSize}m. - The Obsession has your Terror Radius. - You gain {Keyword.Undetectable}.

perks.name: Dead Hard
perks.description:
Whenever you are unhooked, while injured and running, use {Input.ActivatableButton1}:
    - You gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S10P02.EnduranceDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S10P02.ExhaustedDuration}s.

perks.name: Dead Man’s Switch
perks.description: When you hook a Survivor, the first time a Survivor stops repairing a Generator, it is blocked for {Tunable.K19P02.GeneratorBlockDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K19P02.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.

perks.name: Deathbound
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another, they scream. Then, until they take damage, while they are at least {Tunable.K20P03.MaximumDistance}m away from that Survivor:
    - They gain {Keyword.Oblivious}. - They see that Survivor's Aura.

perks.name: Decisive Strike
perks.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S06P02.EffectDuration}s: when the Killer picks you up, once per trial, hit a Special Skill check:
    - Stun the Killer for {Tunable.S06P02.StunDuration}s. - Become the Obsession.
This is disabled by conspicuous actions. At the start of the trial, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

perks.name: Deerstalker
perks.description:
Every {Tunable.KG_Deerstalker.RevealTimeIntervals}s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for {Tunable.KG_Deerstalker.RevealDuration}s.

While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.

perks.name: Deja Vu
perks.description: You see the Auras of the {Tunable.SG_Deja_Vu.GeneratorsShown} Generators closest to each other and repair them {Tunable.SG_Deja_Vu.RepairSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Deliverance
perks.description: Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.S14P02.BrokenDuration}s.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor:
    - You heal {Tunable.S23P02.ExtraActionSpeed%}% faster. - You unhook {Tunable.S23P02.ExtraActionSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Detective's Hunch
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, for {Tunable.S12P02.RevealDuration}s, within {Tunable.S12P02.RevealDistance}m of you:
    - You see the Auras of Chests. - You see the Auras of Generators. - You see the Auras of Totems.

perks.name: Discordance
perks.description:
Within {Tunable.K14P01.EffectRange}m of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you are alerted.

While that Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, this ends after {Tunable.K14P01.AuraLingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Distortion
perks.description:
When the trial starts, and after being chased for {Tunable.S15P03.RegainTokenDuration}s, you earn {Tunable.S15P03.TokensRegained} Token, up to {Tunable.S15P03.MaxTokens}. While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend {Tunable.S15P03.StartingTokenAmount} Token. Then, for the next {Tunable.S15P03.HiddenDuration}s:
    - The Killer cannot see your Aura. - You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Distressing
perks.description: Your Terror Radius is {Tunable.KG_Distressing.TerrorRadiusIncreaseSize%}% larger.

perks.name: Diversion
perks.description:
After hiding for {Tunable.S14P01.RequiredChargeTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, while crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to throw a pebble {Tunable.S14P01.ThrowDistance}m away:
    - The Killer is alerted. - The pebble leaves Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Dragon’s Grip
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, for the next {Tunable.K21P01.ActiveDuration}s, the first Survivor that repairs that Generator:
    - They scream, then you are alerted to their position for {Tunable.K21P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. - They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K21P01.ExposedDuration}s.
Cooldown: {Tunable.K21P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Dying Light
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, earn {Tunable.K06P02.TokensPerHook} token. While the Obsession is alive, for each Token:
    - Other Survivors heal {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower. - Other Survivors repair {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower. - Other Survivors sabotage Hooks {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.
The Obsession:
    - Heals other Survivors {Tunable.K06P02.ObsessionActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - Unhooks other Survivors {Tunable.K06P02.ObsessionActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.

perks.name: Empathy
perks.description: Within {Tunable.S03P01.AuraRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of injured Survivors.

perks.name: Enduring
perks.description: While not carrying a Survivor, Pallet-stuns are {Tunable.K03P01.StunDurationReduction%}% shorter.

perks.name: Fire Up
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn {Tunable.K10P01.TokensPerGenerator} Token, up to {Tunable.K10P01.MaxTokens}. For each Token:
    - You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - You damage Generators {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - You pick-up and drop Survivors {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.

perks.name: Fixated
perks.description:
While walking, you gain {Tunable.S19P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

You see your own Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Flip-Flop
perks.description: While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, {Tunable.S17P01.RecoveryRatio%}% of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to {Tunable.S17P01.MaxWiggle%}%.

perks.name: Forced Penance
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor takes a protection hit, they gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.K20P01.BrokenDuration}s.

perks.name: For the People
perks.description:
While healthy and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to heal them instantly:
    - You take damage. - You gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.S21P03.BrokenDuration}s. - You become the Obsession.
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

perks.name: Franklin's Demise
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they drop their item.

Within {Tunable.K09P03.ItemsRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of dropped items.

perks.name: Furtive Chase
perks.description:
Whenever you hook the Obsession:
    - You gain {Tunable.K16P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K16P03.UndetectableHasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K16P03.UndetectableHasteDuration}s.
Whenever the Obsession is unhooked, the Survivor who unhooked them becomes the Obsession.

perks.name: Gearhead
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next {Tunable.K19P01.EffectDuration}s, whenever a Survivor repairing a Generator hits a good basic Skill Check, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K19P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Overcharge
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
    - Its regression speed will go from {Tunable.K07P03.StartingRegressionSpeed%}% to {Tunable.K07P03.MaxRegressionSpeed%}% over the next {Tunable.K07P03.RegressionRampDuration}s. - The next Survivor who starts repairing it gets a special Skill Check. If they miss it, they lose {Tunable.K07P03.GenRegressionOnFail%}% more progress.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

While carrying a Survivor, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K11P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor starts sabotaging a Hook, you are alerted.

perks.name: Head On
perks.description: After hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S16P03.HideRequiredDuration}s, fast-exit to stun the Killer for {Tunable.S16P03.LockerStunDuration}s if they are within {Tunable.S16P03.LockerStunRange}m, then gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S16P03.ExhaustedDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Devour Hope
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites. Whenever a Survivor is unhooked while you are at least {Tunable.K05P03.DistanceFromHook}m away, earn {Tunable.K05P03.TokensPerUnhook} Token, up to {Tunable.K05P03.MaxTokens}:
    - 2 Tokens | {Tunable.K05P03.HasteDelayDuration}s after hooking a Survivor, gain {Tunable.K05P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K05P03.HasteDuration}s. - 3 Tokens | Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed}. - 5 Tokens | You can Kill downed Survivors.

perks.name: Hex: Haunted Ground
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite. When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed:
    - All Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K13P02.ExposedDuration}s. - The other Totem is extinguished.

perks.name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn {Tunable.K08P03.TokensPerHook} Token. For each Token, Basic Skill Check warnings appear later and good success zones are smaller.

While you have 5 Tokens, Basic Skill Check warnings don't appear.

Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, they lose {Tunable.K08P03.RegressionBonus%}% more progress.

perks.name: Hex: Ruin
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

While a Generator is not being repaired, it regresses at {Tunable.K05P02.RegressionSpeed%}% speed.

perks.name: Hex: The Third Seal
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic or special-attack, they gain {Keyword.Blindness}.

This applies for up to {Tunable.K05P01.MaxAffectedSurvivors} Survivors.

perks.name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

For each Dull and Hex Totem remaining, you have {Tunable.KG_Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.TokensPerTotem} Token.

For each Token, Survivors bless and cleanse totems {Tunable.KG_Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.ActionSpeedReductionPerToken%}% slower.

perks.name: Hex: Blood Favor
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor, Upright Pallets within {Tunable.K21P03.EffectRadius}m of them are blocked for {Tunable.K21P03.BlockDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Retribution
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor starts blessing or cleansing a Totem, they gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K19P03.ObliviousDuration}s.

Whenever a Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.K19P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Undying
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

When another Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, it replaces this one and keeps any Tokens it had.

You see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K21P02.AuraRevealDistance}m of Dull Totems.

perks.name: Hope
perks.description: When all Generators are completed, you gain {Tunable.SG_Hope.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

perks.name: I'm All Ears
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor fast-enters or fast-exits a Locker, or medium or fast-vaults within {Tunable.K16P01.ActivationRange}m of you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K16P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K16P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Infectious Fright
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor is downed, Survivors within your Terror Radius scream and you are alerted for {Tunable.K15P02.RevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Inner Strength
perks.description: Whenever you cleanse a Totem, while injured and not {Keyword.Broken}, after hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S19P03.HideDuration}s, you become healthy instantly.

perks.name: Insidious
perks.description: After being idle for {Tunable.KG_Insidious.TimeToActivate}s, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} until you act.

perks.name: Knock Out
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next {Tunable.K09P01.TriggerTime}s, if they move {Tunable.K09P01.DistanceThreshold}m away from it, they gain {Tunable.K09P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K09P01.HinderedDuration}s.

perks.name: Iron Grasp
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
    - They wiggle {Tunable.KG_Iron_Grasp.WiggleTimeIncrease%}% slower. - Their wiggle is {Tunable.KG_Iron_Grasp.WiggleStrengthReduction%}% weaker.

perks.name: Iron Will
perks.description: While injured and not {Keyword.Exhausted}, your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S04P01.InjuredNoiseReduction%}% quieter.

perks.name: Iron Maiden
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker:
    - They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K14P03.ExposedDuration}s. - They scream, then you are alerted to their location for {Tunable.K14P03.RevealDuration}s.
You open Lockers {Tunable.K14P03.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Hoarder
perks.description:
When the trial starts, {Tunable.K22P01.ExtraChestsSpawned} more Chests appear.

Whenever a Survivor picks-up an Item or starts unlocking a Chest within {Tunable.K22P01.RevealDistance}m of you, you are alerted.

perks.name: Oppression
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, up to {Tunable.K22P02.AffectedGenerators} other Generators start regressing. Survivors repairing them get a special Skill Check. Cooldown: {Tunable.K22P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Coup de Grâce
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn {Tunable.K22P03.TokensGainedPerGenerator} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K22P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you lunge-attack, spend {Tunable.K22P03.TokensSpentPerLunge} Token to make it {Tunable.K22P03.LungeExtraDuration%}% longer.

perks.name: Starstruck
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain {Keyword.Exposed}. This ends {Tunable.K23P01.ExposedLingerDuration}s after:
    - They leave your Terror Radius. - You drop or Hook the carried Survivor.
Cooldown: {Tunable.K23P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Hex: Crowd Control
perks.description:
The first time a Survivor medium or fast-vaults a Window, a Dull Totem ignites.

The last {Tunable.K23P02.MaximumVaultsBlocked} Windows Survivors medium or fast-vault are blocked.

You basic-vault blocked Windows {Tunable.K23P02.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

You see the Auras of blocked Windows within {Tunable.K23P02.AuraRevealDistance}m.

perks.name: No Way Out
perks.description:
The first time you Hook each Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K23P03.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token. When all Generators are completed, when a Survivor starts opening an Exit Gate:
    - It is blocked {Tunable.K23P03.GateBlockBaseDuration}s, plus {Tunable.K23P03.GateBlockDurationPerToken}s for each Token. - You are alerted.

perks.name: Lethal Pursuer
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.K24P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever you see a Survivor's Aura for a duration, it is {Tunable.K24P01.BonusAuraRevealDuration}s longer.

perks.name: Hysteria
perks.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, all injured Survivors gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K24P02.ObliviousDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K24P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Eruption
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, when you down a Survivor, all Generators damaged this way:
    - Explode, lose {Tunable.K24P03.GeneratorRegress%}% progress and start regressing. - Survivors repairing them scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K24P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
Cooldown: {Tunable.K24P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Deadlock
perks.description: Whenever a Generator is completed, the Generator with the most progress is blocked for {Tunable.K25P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Plaything
perks.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites. For {Tunable.K25P02.TotemBlockDuration}s, the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors. The hexed Survivors:
    - Gain {Keyword.Oblivious}. - Within {Tunable.K25P02.TotemAuraRevealDistance}m of the Hex totem, they see its Aura.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks. Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook:
    - They gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage} for {Tunable.K25P03.MangledHemorrhageDuration}s. - They gain {Keyword.Mangled} for {Tunable.K25P03.MangledHemorrhageDuration}s. - When they are healed, until they take damage, they heal and repair {Tunable.K25P03.ActionSpeedDebuff%}% slower.

perks.name: Grim Embrace
perks.description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor for the first time, earn {Tunable.K26P01.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token. When you move {Tunable.K26P01.HookedDistance}m away from the hooked Survivor, all Generators are blocked for {Tunable.K26P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s. When you have {Tunable.K26P01.SurvivorsToBeHooked} Tokens, when you move {Tunable.K26P01.HookedDistance}m away from the hooked Survivor:
    - All Generators are blocked for {Tunable.K26P01.FinalGeneratorBlockDuration}s. - You see the Obsession's Aura for {Tunable.K26P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
perks.description:
When the trial starts:
    - 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks. - You earn {Tunable.K26P02.StartingTokens} Tokens.
The first time each Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, spend {Tunable.K26P02.TokensSpentOnUniqueHook} Token, then the Generator with the most progress:
    - Explodes, loses {Tunable.K26P02.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and starts regressing. - Survivors repairing it scream.

perks.name: Hex: Pentimento
perks.description:
You see the Auras of cleansed Totems, and can rekindle each once.

Within {Tunable.K26P03.TotemAuraReveaDistance}m, Survivors see the Auras of Rekindled Totems.

While a totem is rekindled, Survivors heal and repair {Tunable.K26P03.BaseActionSpeedPenalty%}% slower, plus {Tunable.K26P03.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerTotem%}% for each additional Rekindled Totem.

When all {Tunable.K26P03.MaxTokens} Totems are rekindled at once, they are blocked.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, you see the Auras of other Survivors for {Tunable.K27P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Call of Brine
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses {Tunable.K27P02.RegressionModifier%}% faster for {Tunable.K27P02.Duration}s.

For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.

perks.name: Merciless Storm
perks.description: The first time each Generator has {Tunable.K27P03.GeneratorProgressionRequired%}% progress: Survivors repairing it get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop repairing, that Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K27P03.GeneratorBlockedDuration}s.

perks.name: Dissolution
perks.description: {Tunable.K28P01.TimeBeforeTrigger}s after a Survivor takes damage, for {Tunable.K28P01.EffectDuration}s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed.

perks.name: Darkness Revealed
perks.description: Whenever you search a Locker, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K28P02.DetectionDistance}m of Lockers for {Tunable.K28P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K28P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Septic Touch
perks.description:
While a Survivor within your Terror Radius is healing:
    - They gain {Keyword.Blindness}. - They gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.
When they stop healing, this ends after {Tunable.K28P03.BlindnessExhaustionDuration}s.

perks.name: Superior Anatomy
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor fast-vaults within {Tunable.K29P01.SurvivorVaultDistance}m of you, the next time you basic-vault a window, it is {Tunable.K29P01.VaultSpeed%}% faster. Cooldown: {Tunable.K29P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Awakened Awareness
perks.description: While carrying a Survivor, within {Tunable.K29P02.AuraRevealDistance}m of you, you see the Auras of other Survivors.

perks.name: Terminus
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain {Keyword.Broken}.

When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after {Tunable.K29P03.BrokenDuration}s.

perks.name: Nowhere to Hide
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for {Tunable.K30P01.AuraRevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K30P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of you.

perks.name: Hex: Face the Darkness
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

Every {Tunable.K30P02.ScreamInterval}s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K30P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.

perks.name: Hubris
perks.description: Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, they gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K30P03.ExposedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K30P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Game Afoot
perks.description:
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain {Tunable.K31P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K31P01.HasteDuration}s.

Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.

perks.name: THWACK!
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.K31P02.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K31P02.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K31P02.TokenGainOnHook} Token.

Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend {Tunable.K31P02.TokensSpentPerBreak} Token. Then, all Survivors within {Tunable.K31P02.Range}m scream and you see their Auras for {Tunable.K31P02.RevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Leverage
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves, they heal {Tunable.K31P03.HealPenalty%}% slower for {Tunable.K31P03.ReduceHealingDuration}s.

perks.name: Genetic Limits
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K32P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.

perks.name: Forced Hesitation
perks.description: Whenever you down a Survivor, other Survivors within {Tunable.K32P02.RequiredDistance}m of the downed Survivor gain {Tunable.K32P02.Hinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K32P02.HinderedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K32P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Machine Learning
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it becomes Compromised. When that Generator is completed by Survivors:
    - You gain {Tunable.K32P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K32P03.PerkDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K32P03.PerkDuration}s.
Only one Generator can be compromised at a time.

perks.name: Ultimate Weapon
perks.description:
Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within {Tunable.K33P01.RequiredDistance}m:
    - Gain {Keyword.Blindness} for {Tunable.K33P01.BlindnessDuration}s. - Scream.
Cooldown: {Tunable.K33P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Rapid Brutality
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, you gain {Tunable.K33P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K33P02.HasteDuration}s.

While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.

perks.name: Alien Instinct
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, the farthest injured Survivor:
    - Gains {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K33P03.ObliviousDuration}s. - You see their Aura for {Tunable.K33P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Two Can Play
perks.description:
While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor {Tunable.K34P01.StunnedOrBlindedTimesRequired} times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for {Tunable.K34P01.BlindedDuration}s.

perks.name: Friends ‘Til the End
perks.description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession:
    - The Obsession gains {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K34P02.ExposedDuration}s. - You see the Obsession's Aura for {Tunable.K34P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
Whenever you Hook the Obsession, another Survivor:
    - Screams, then you are alerted. - Becomes the Obsession.

perks.name: Batteries Included
perks.description: Within {Tunable.K34P03.RequiredDistance}m of a completed Generator, you gain {Tunable.K34P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When you leave the range, this ends after {Tunable.K34P03.HasteLingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Unbound
perks.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next {Tunable.K35P01.EffectDuration}s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain {Tunable.K35P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K35P01.HasteDuration}s.

perks.name: Unforeseen
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
    - Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for {Tunable.K35P02.EffectDuration}s and its radius is {Tunable.K35P02.TerrorRadiusSize}m. - You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for that time.
Cooldown: {Tunable.K35P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Undone
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, earn {Tunable.K35P03.TokenGain} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K35P03.MaxTokens}. Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent:
    - The Generator loses {Tunable.K35P03.GeneratorRegressionPerToken%}% progress. - The Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K35P03.BlockTimePerToken}s.
When that Generator is unblocked, it begins regressing. Cooldown: {Tunable.K35P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Weave Attunement
perks.description:
The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped. While a Survivor is within {Tunable.K36P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of a dropped item:
    - You see their Aura. - They see the item's Aura.
Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K36P01.ObliviousDuration}s.

perks.name: Languid Touch
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor within {Tunable.K36P02.RangeFromKiller}m of you scares a Crow, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K36P02.ExhaustedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K36P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Dark Arrogance
perks.description:
You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K36P03.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is {Tunable.K36P03.ExtraBlindStunDuration%}% longer.

perks.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
perks.description:
The first time a Generator is completed, a Dull Totem ignites. The Obsession:
    - Repairs {Tunable.K37P01.RepairSpeedPenalty%}% slower. - Sees the Hex Totem's Aura within {Tunable.K37P01.AuraRevealDistance}m.

perks.name: Human Greed
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor gets within {Tunable.K37P02.AuraRevealRange}m of a locked Chest, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K37P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You can lock unlocked Chests. Cooldown: {Tunable.K37P02.Cooldown}s.

You see the Auras of locked Chests.

perks.name: Dominance
perks.description: The first time each Chest is being unlocked and each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, it is blocked for {Tunable.K37P03.BlockDuration}s.

perks.name: All-Shaking Thunder
perks.description: Whenever you fall from at least {Tunable.K38P01.RequiredFallHeight}m, your lunge-attacks are {Tunable.K38P01.LungeAttackExtra%}% longer for {Tunable.K38P01.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K38P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
perks.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.

Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for {Tunable.K38P02.GeneratorRevealDuration}s, you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.

perks.name: No Quarter
perks.description: While self-healing, whenever a Survivor has {Tunable.K38P03.SelfHealTrigger%}% progress, they get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop healing, they gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.K38P03.BrokenDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
perks.description:
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack {Tunable.K39P01.BasicHitsRequired} times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they gain {Tunable.K39P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K39P01.HinderedDuration}s.

perks.name: Forever Entwined
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, you earn {Tunable.K39P02.TokensPerDamage} Token, up to {Tunable.K39P02.MaxTokens}. For each Token:
    - You hook Survivors {Tunable.K39P02.BonusPerToken%}% faster. - You pick-up and drop Survivors {Tunable.K39P02.BonusPerToken%}% faster.

perks.name: None Are Free
perks.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, earn {Tunable.K39P03.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token. When all Generators are completed, for each Token:
    - Upright Pallets are blocked for {Tunable.K39P03.BlockDurationPerToken}s. - Windows are blocked for {Tunable.K39P03.BlockDurationPerToken}s.

perks.name: Help Wanted
perks.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.

When that Generator is completed by Survivors, your basic-attack cooldowns are {Tunable.K40P01.AttackCooldownReduction%}% shorter for {Tunable.K40P01.Duration}s.

Only 1 Generator can be compromised at a time.

perks.name: Phantom Fear
perks.description: Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream, then you see their Aura for {Tunable.K40P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K40P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Haywire
perks.description:
Exit Gate Switches with at least {Tunable.K40P03.RegressionThreshold%}% progress regress at {Tunable.K40P03.RegressionRate%}% speed.

While they are regressing, Survivors see the Exit Gate Lights flicker randomly.

perks.name: Ravenous
perks.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K41P01.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token. When you have {Tunable.K41P01.MaxTokens} Tokens, all Survivors:
    - Scream. - Gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K41P01.ExposedDuration}s.

perks.name: Wandering Eye
perks.description: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K41P02.RevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within {Tunable.K41P02.RevealDistance}m. Cooldown: {Tunable.K41P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Hex: Overture of Doom
perks.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it. After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for {Tunable.K41P03.RequiredTime} seconds:
    - You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K41P03.TerrorRadiusDisplacementDuration}s. - For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.
When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.

perks.name: Turn Back The Clock
perks.description: After hooking a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K42P01.Duration}s, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to make target Generator you can see within {Tunable.K42P01.Range}m explode, lose {Tunable.K42P01.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and start regressing.

perks.name: Secret Project
perks.description:
Whenever a totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K42P02.BlockDuration}s.

Whenever 1 or more Generators are blocked, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K42P02.UndetectableDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: Hive Mind
perks.description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites. The Auras of Generators show their progress. When {Tunable.K42P03.GeneratorsToActivate} Generator remains:
    - All Generators explode, lose {Tunable.K42P03.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and start regressing. - The Hex Totem is extinguished.

perks.name: Hex: Scared to Death
perks.description:
After you hook {Tunable.K43P01.UniqueSurvivorsToHook} different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites. While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within {Tunable.K43P01.DistanceToSurvivors}m:
    - Scream. - Gain {Tunable.K43P01.HinderedValue}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K43P01.HinderedDuration}s.

perks.name: Silent Shadow
perks.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K43P02.StartTrialUndetectableDuration}s.

When all Generators are completed, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable}.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description:
Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn {Tunable.K43P03.TokensGained} Token, up to {Tunable.K43P03.TokensMaximum}.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next {Tunable.K43P03.HasteDuration}s you gain {Tunable.K43P03.HasteValue}% {Keyword.Haste} for each Token. Cooldown: {Tunable.K43P03.Cooldown}.

perks.name: Celestial Witness
perks.description: Every {Tunable.K044P01.Timer}s, if the Obsession is at least {Tunable.K044P01.Distance}m away from you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K044P01.AuraDuration}s. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

perks.name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
perks.description:
The first time a Survivor gains a Hook State, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a running Survivor gains {Keyword.Haste} within {Tunable.K044P02.HasteRange}m of you, you are alerted.

Running Survivors cannot gain more than {Tunable.K044P02.HasteCap}% {Keyword.Haste} at a time.

perks.name: Lay Waste
perks.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses {Tunable.K044P03.FasterRegression}% faster. Cooldown: {Tunable.K044P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Kindred
perks.description:
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Kindred.AuraRevealDistance}m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura.

While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Kindred.AuraRevealDistance}m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura.

perks.name: Leader
perks.description:
Within {Tunable.S01P02.Range}m of you, other Survivors:
    - Cleanse Totems {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster. - Heal {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster. - Open Exit Gates {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster. - Sabotage Hooks {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster. - Unhook Survivors {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster. - Unlock Chests {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
After they leave your range, this ends after {Tunable.S01P02.LingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Left Behind
perks.description: When all other Survivors are dead, while within {Tunable.S08P01.HatchRevealDistance}m of the Hatch, you see its Aura.

perks.name: Lightborn
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor attempts to blind you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K03P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You cannot be blinded.

perks.name: Lightweight
perks.description: Your Scratch Marks disappear {Tunable.SG_Lightweight.ScratchmarksTimeReduction}s faster and appear more spread out.

perks.name: Lithe
perks.description:
Whenever you medium or fast-vault:
    - You gain {Tunable.S09P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S09P02.HasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S09P02.ExhaustionDuration}s.

perks.name: Lucky Break
perks.description:
While injured, for up to {Tunable.S20P01.MaxDuration}s:
    - You leave no Pools of Blood. - You leave no Scratch Marks.
For each second spent healing another Survivor, recharge the duration by {Tunable.S20P01.TimePerHealingSecond}s.

perks.name: Mad Grit
perks.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
    - Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is {Tunable.K14P02.AttackCooldownReduction}% shorter. - Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, the carried Survivor gains no wiggle progress for {Tunable.K14P02.WigglePauseDuration}s.

perks.name: Make your Choice
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves while you are at least {Tunable.K11P03.MinimumDistance}m away:
    - They scream. - They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K11P03.ExposedDuration}s.
Cooldown: {Tunable.K11P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Mindbreaker
perks.description:
While Survivors are repairing a Generator:
    - They gain {Keyword.Blindness}. - They gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.
When they stop repairing a Generator, this ends after {Tunable.K17P03.LingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Monitor & Abuse
perks.description:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusIncrease%}% bigger.

While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusDecrease%}% smaller.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
perks.description:
When the trial starts:
    - 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks. - The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
While you are at least {Tunable.KG_Monstrous_Shrine.Range}m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, they are sacrificed {Tunable.KG_Monstrous_Shrine.FasterProgress%}% faster.

perks.name: Nemesis
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor blinds you, Locker-stuns or Pallet-stuns you, they become the Obsession. Whenever a Survivor becomes the Obsession:
    - They gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K18P03.ObliviousDuration}s. - You see their Aura for {Tunable.K18P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed, a Dull Totem ignites:
    - Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed}. - You gain {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
Within {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.AuraRevealStartRange}m, Survivors see the Hex Totem's Aura, expanding to {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.AuraRevealEndRange}m over {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.AuraSizeIncreaseDelay}s.

perks.name: No One Left Behind
perks.description:
When all Generators are completed:
    - You heal {Tunable.SG_No_One_Left_Behind.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You unhook other Survivors {Tunable.SG_No_One_Left_Behind.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - Whenever you unhook a Survivor, they gain {Tunable.SG_No_One_Left_Behind.IncreasedHaste%}% more {Keyword.Haste}. - You see the Auras of other Survivors.

perks.name: No Mither
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you become injured, then:
    - You gain {Keyword.Broken}. - Your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S10P03.InjuredVoiceLevelReduction%}% quieter. - You leave no Pools of Blood. - You recover {Tunable.S10P03.ExtraRecover%}% faster. - You can fully recover.

perks.name: A Nurse's Calling
perks.description: Within {Tunable.K04P03.AuraRevealDistance}m of Survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their Auras.

perks.name: Object of Obsession
perks.description:
While you are the Obsession, every {Tunable.S06P03.RevealTimeIntervals}s, the Killer sees your Aura for {Tunable.S06P03.AuraRevealDuration}s. While the Killer sees your Aura:
    - You see their Aura. - You cleanse totems {Tunable.S06P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - You heal {Tunable.S06P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - You repair {Tunable.S06P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

perks.name: Off the Record
perks.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S21P01.Duration}s:
    - You gain {Keyword.Endurance}. - Your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S21P01.InjuredVoiceLevelReduction%}% quieter. - The Killer cannot see your Aura.

perks.name: Open-Handed
perks.description: All Survivors see Auras that have a range from {Tunable.S07P01.AuraIncreaseDistance}m farther.

perks.name: Overwhelming Presence
perks.description:
Whenever a Survivor uses an item within {Tunable.K07P01.DistanceToSurvivorDistance}m of you, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K07P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.

Whenever a Survivor within {Tunable.K07P01.DistanceToSurvivorDistance}m of you gains {Keyword.Exhausted}, you see the closest {Keyword.Exhausted} Survivor's Aura for {Tunable.K07P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K07P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Pharmacy
perks.description:
Whenever you unlock a Chest, it will contain a rare Med-Kit.

You unlock Chests {Tunable.S11P02.SearchSpeeds%}% faster.

The range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is {Tunable.S11P02.NoiseReductionDistance}m shorter.

perks.name: Play With Your Food
perks.description:
Whenever you stop chasing the Obsession, you earn {Tunable.K06P03.TokensGained} Token, up to {Tunable.K06P03.MaxTokens}. Cooldown: {Tunable.K06P03.ChargeGainedCooldown}s.

For each Token, gain {Tunable.K06P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

Whenever you attack, lose {Tunable.K06P03.TokensLostOnAction} Token.

perks.name: Plunderer's Instinct
perks.description:
Within {Tunable.SG_Plunderers_Instinct.ChestAuraRevealDistance}m of locked Chests and dropped items, you see their Auras.

Whenever you unlock a Chest, you are {Tunable.SG_Plunderers_Instinct.ModifyChestRarity}% more likely to find an item of higher rarity.

perks.name: Poised
perks.description:
The first time you start repairing each Generator, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S16P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever a Generator is completed, you leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S16P02.StealthDuration}s.

perks.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
perks.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K12P03.ActiveDuration}s, when you damage a Generator, it explodes and loses {Tunable.K12P03.ExtraGeneratorDamage%}% more progress.

perks.name: Predator
perks.description: When you stop chasing a Survivor, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K02P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K02P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Premonition
perks.description: While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Premonition.PerkEffectDistance}m of you and inside a {Tunable.SG_Premonition.ActivationAngle} degree cone, whenever you look at them, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: {Tunable.SG_Premonition.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Prove Thyself
perks.description: For each other Survivor within {Tunable.S01P03.Range}m of you, all Survivors repair {Tunable.S01P03.RepairBonusPerSurvivor%}% faster.

perks.name: Quick & Quiet
perks.description: You hide in Lockers and vault silently. The Killer is not alerted. Cooldown: {Tunable.S02P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Rancor
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
    - You are alerted to the position of all Survivors for {Tunable.K13P03.SurvivorRevealDuration}s. - The Obsession sees your Aura for {Tunable.K13P03.KillerRevealDuration}s.
When all Generators are completed:
    - The Obsession gains {Keyword.Exposed}. - You can Kill the Obsession.

perks.name: Red Herring
perks.description:
After you repair a Generator for at least {Tunable.S21P02.TimeToActivate}s, you see its Aura.

When you hide in a Locker, the Killer is alerted to the Generator. Cooldown: {Tunable.S21P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Remember Me
perks.description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to {Tunable.K10P02.MaximumTokens}.

For each Token, Survivors who are not the Obsession open Exit Gates {Tunable.K10P02.ActionSpeedPenalty%}% slower.

perks.name: Repressed Alliance
perks.description: After repairing Generators for {Tunable.S22P03.RepairTimeNeeded}s, while repairing a Generator alone, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to block that generator for {Tunable.S22P03.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.

perks.name: Resilience
perks.description:
While injured:
    - You bless and cleanse Totems {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You heal {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You open Exit Gates {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You repair {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You sabotage Hooks {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You unhook Survivors {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You unlock chests {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster. - You vault {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Appraisal
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S24P01.StartingTokens} Tokens.

Spend {Tunable.S24P01.TokensPerRummage} Token to rummage an empty Chest, up to {Tunable.S24P01.MaxRummagesPerChest} times per Chest.

You rummage Chests {Tunable.S24P01.ChestSearchSpeedBonus%}% faster.

perks.name: Deception
perks.description:
Whenever you attempt to fast-enter a Locker:
    - You do not enter the Locker. - The Killer is alerted. - You leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S24P02.NoScratchMarksDuration}s. - You leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S24P02.NoScratchMarksDuration}s.
Cooldown: {Tunable.S24P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Power Struggle
perks.description:
While carried by the Killer, while you have at least {Tunable.S24P03.WiggleRequired%}% wiggle and next to an Upright Pallet, you can drop it to stun the Killer.

While downed, you see the Auras of Upright Pallets.

perks.name: Fast Track
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn {Tunable.S25P01.TokensPerHook} Token, up to {Tunable.S25P01.MaxTokens}.

While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains {Tunable.S25P01.BonusPerToken%}% permanent progress.

perks.name: Smash Hit
perks.description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
    - You gain {Tunable.S25P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S25P02.HasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S25P02.ExhaustedDuration}s.

perks.name: Self-Preservation
perks.description: Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain {Keyword.Elusive} for {Tunable.S25P03.Duration}s.

perks.name: Counterforce
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S26P01.StartingTokens} Token.

Whenever you cleanse a Totem, earn {Tunable.S26P01.TokensPerCleanse} Token, then, you see the Aura of the farthest Totem for {Tunable.S26P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

For each Token, you cleanse Totems {Tunable.S26P01.StackableCleanseSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Resurgence
perks.description: Whenever you are unhooked, you gain {Tunable.S26P02.HealRegain%}% healing progress.

perks.name: Blast Mine
perks.description:
After repairing {Tunable.S26P03.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S26P03.TrapDuration}s. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time. When the Killer damages that Generator, the trap explodes, then:
    - They are stunned for {Tunable.S26P03.StunBlindDuration}s. - Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.

perks.name: Bite the Bullet
perks.description:
While healing, you and the healed Survivor make no noises or Grunts of Pain. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check:
    - You lose only {Tunable.S27P01.OverrideHealFailPenalty%}% progress. - The Killer is not alerted.

perks.name: Flashbang
perks.description:
After repairing {Tunable.S27P02.RequiredProgressToCraft%}% of Generators, while hiding in a Locker, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to craft a Flashbang. When you use the Flashbang:
    - Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded. - The Killer is alerted.

perks.name: Rookie Spirit
perks.description: After you hit {Tunable.S27P03.SkillchecksRequiredAmount} basic repair Skill Checks, while a Generator is regressing, you see its Aura.

perks.name: Clairvoyance
perks.description:
Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, while not holding an item, use {Input.UseItem} to, for up to {Tunable.S28P01.AuraRevealDuration}s and within {Tunable.S28P01.AuraRevealDistance}m:
    - See the Auras of Chests. - See the Auras of Exit Gate Switches. - See the Auras of Generators. - See the Aura of the Hatch. - See the Auras of Hooks.

perks.name: Boon: Circle of Healing
perks.description:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range:
    - While healing without a Med-Kit, they heal others {Tunable.S28P02.HealingSpeedBonus%}% faster. - While injured, other Survivors see their Aura.

perks.name: Boon: Shadow Step
perks.description:
While next to a Totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range:
    - Leave no Scratch Marks. - Their Auras cannot be seen by the Killer.
When leaving the range, this ends after {Tunable.S28P03.LingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Overcome
perks.description:
Whenever you take damage:
    - You retain your speed boost for {Tunable.S29P01.ExtraBoostTime}s longer. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S29P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.

perks.name: Corrective Action
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S29P02.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.S29P02.MaxTokens}. Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, earn {Tunable.S29P02.TokensGainedPerGreat} Token. Whenever another Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, spend {Tunable.S29P02.TokensSpentPerMiss} Token:
    - The missed Skill Check becomes a good Skill Check. - You see that Survivor's Aura for {Tunable.S29P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Boon: Exponential
perks.description:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons. Downed Survivors within the Boon's range:
    - Recover {Tunable.S29P03.RecoverSpeedBoost%}% faster. - Can fully recover.

perks.name: Parental Guidance
perks.description:
Whenever you stun the Killer, for {Tunable.S30P01.StealthDuration}s:
    - You make no Grunts of Pain. - You leave no Pools of Blood. - You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Empathic Connection
perks.description:
You heal other Survivors {Tunable.S30P02.HealingBonus%}% faster.

Injured Survivors see your Aura.

perks.name: Boon: Dark Theory
perks.description:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range gain {Tunable.S30P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When leaving the range, this ends after {Tunable.S30P03.LingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Inner Focus
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer damages another Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S31P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You see other Survivors' Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Residual Manifest
perks.description:
Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain {Keyword.Blindness} for {Tunable.S31P02.BlindnessDuration}s.

You can rummage Chests {Tunable.S31P02.MaxRummagePerChest} time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Flashlight.

perks.name: Overzealous
perks.description: Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, until you take damage, you repair {Tunable.S31P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. If that Totem was a Hex Totem, the effect is doubled.

perks.name: Wiretap
perks.description:
After repairing {Tunable.S32P01.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S32P01.TrapDuration}s or until the Killer damages that Generator. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

While the Killer is within {Tunable.S32P01.AuraRevealRange}m of that Generator, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura.

perks.name: Reactive Healing
perks.description: While injured, whenever another Survivor within {Tunable.S32P02.MaximumDistance}m of you takes damage, you gain {Tunable.S32P02.HealingProgressionIncrease%}% missing healing progress.

perks.name: Low Profile
perks.description:
When all other Survivors are downed or hooked, for {Tunable.S32P03.EffectDuration}s:
    - You make no Grunts of Pain. - You leave no Pools of Blood. - You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Better Than New
perks.description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage:
    - They bless and cleanse {Tunable.S33P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - They heal {Tunable.S33P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. - They unlock Chests {Tunable.S33P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.

perks.name: Reassurance
perks.description: Once per Hook State, while within {Tunable.S33P02.RadiusDistance}m of a hooked Survivor, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to stop the sacrifice progress for {Tunable.S33P02.StrugglePauseDuration}s.

perks.name: Hyperfocus
perks.description:
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S33P03.TokensPerGreat} Token, up to {Tunable.S33P03.MaxTokens}. For each Token, basic Skill Checks:
    - Appear {Tunable.S33P03.SkillCheckBonusChance%}% more often. - Spin {Tunable.S33P03.SkillCheckSpeedIncrease%}% faster. - Whenever you hit a great, give {Tunable.S33P03.SkillCheckBonusPerToken%}% more progress.
Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, hit a good Skill Check, or stop healing or repairing, lose all Tokens.

perks.name: Potential Energy
perks.description:
While repairing, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to earn Tokens instead of progress, up to {Tunable.S34P01.MaxTokens} Tokens.

While you have at least {Tunable.S34P01.TokensToActivate} Token, {Input.ActivatableButton2} to spend all Tokens and gain {Tunable.S34P01.ProgressPerToken%}% progress for each Token spent.

Whenever you take damage, lose all Tokens.

perks.name: Fogwise
perks.description: While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S34P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Quick Gambit
perks.description:
While chased by the Killer:
    - You see the Auras of other Survivors. - Other Survivors repair {Tunable.S34P03.RepairBoost%}% faster.
Whenever you take damage, cooldown: {Tunable.S34P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Cut Loose
perks.description:
While chased by the Killer, whenever you medium or fast-vault:
    - For up to {Tunable.S35P01.StealthDuration}s, your medium and fast vaults are silent. - During that time, whenever you medium or fast-vault, the timer is reset.
Cooldown: {Tunable.S35P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Friendly Competition
perks.description: Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair {Tunable.S35P02.ExtraRepairSpeed%}% faster for {Tunable.S35P02.BoostDuration}s.

perks.name: Teamwork: Power of Two
perks.description: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while you stay within {Tunable.S35P03.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both gain {Tunable.S35P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after {Tunable.S35P03.LingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Background Player
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer picks-up another Survivor, for the next {Tunable.S36P01.EffectDuration}s, when you start running:
    - Gain {Tunable.S36P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S36P01.HasteDuration}s. - Gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S36P01.ExhaustedDuration}s.

perks.name: Blood Rush
perks.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S36P02.EffectDuration}s, while {Keyword.Exhausted}, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to lose {Keyword.Exhausted} instantly.

This is disabled by conspicuous actions.

perks.name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
perks.description: Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, while within {Tunable.S36P03.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both leave no Scratch Marks. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after {Tunable.S36P03.LingerDuration}s.

perks.name: Troubleshooter
perks.description:
While chased by the Killer:
    - You see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress. - Whenever you drop a Pallet, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S37P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
When the Killer stops chasing you, this ends after {Tunable.S37P01.LingeringDuration}s.

perks.name: Made for This
perks.description:
While injured, whenever you finish healing another Survivor, you gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S37P02.EnduranceDuration}s.

While you have {Keyword.DeepWound}, you gain {Tunable.S37P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.description:
While repairing and while your Toolbox is empty, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S37P03.TokensPerGreat} Token. When you have {Tunable.S37P03.MaxTokens} Tokens, spend them all:
    - Your Toolbox is recharged instantly. - You repair {Tunable.S37P03.RepairDebuff%}% slower for {Tunable.S37P03.RepairDebuffDuration}s.
You can rummage Chests {Tunable.S37P03.Rummages} time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Toolbox.

perks.name: Dramaturgy
perks.description:
While healthy and running, use {Input.ActivatableButton1}:
    - You gain {Tunable.S38P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S38P01.HasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S38P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.
Then, one happens at random:
    - You gain {Tunable.S38P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S38P01.HasteDuration}s. - You gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.S38P01.ExposedDuration}s. - You gain a random rare item with random add-ons. - You scream, but nothing happens.
The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.

perks.name: Scene Partner
perks.description:
While you are within the Killer's Terror Radius, whenever you look at them:
    - Scream, then see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S38P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. - There is a {Tunable.S38P02.ChanceOfExtraScream%}% chance you will scream again. If you do, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S38P02.ExtraAuraRevealDuration}s more.
Cooldown: {Tunable.S38P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Plot Twist
perks.description:
While injured, crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to be downed silently. While downed this way, once per trial:
    - You make no Grunts of Pain. - You leave no Pools of Blood. - You recover {Tunable.S38P03.RecoverySpeedIncrease%}% faster. - You can fully recover.
Whenever you recover this way:
    - You gain {Tunable.S38P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S38P03.HasteDuration}s. - You are healed instantly.
When all Generators are completed, you can use this ability once again.

perks.name: Lucky Star
perks.description:
While hiding in a Locker, you make no Grunts of Pain. Whenever you exit a Locker, for {Tunable.S39P01.EffectDuration}s:
    - You see the Aura of the closest Generator. - You see the Auras of other Survivors. - You make no Grunts of Pain. - You leave no Pools of Blood.
Cooldown: {Tunable.S39P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Chemical Trap
perks.description:
After repairing {Tunable.S39P02.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Dropped Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S39P02.TrapDuration}s. All Survivors see that Pallet's Aura for that time.

When the Killer breaks that Pallet, the trap explodes and they gain {Tunable.S39P02.Hinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.S39P02.HinderDuration}s.

perks.name: Light-footed
perks.description:
While healthy and running, your footsteps are silent to the Killer.

Whenever you do a fast-action, cooldown: {Tunable.S39P03.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Champion of Light
perks.description:
While you are using a Flashlight, you gain {Tunable.S40P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain {Tunable.S40P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.S40P01.HinderedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S40P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Boon: Illumination
perks.description:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range:
    - See the Auras of Chests. - See the Auras of Generators.
While you have a Boon Totem, you bless and cleanse {Tunable.S40P02.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

perks.name: Deadline
perks.description:
While injured, basic Skill Checks:
    - Are {Tunable.S40P03.ExtraSkillCheckChance%}% more likely to appear. - Appear in random places.
Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose {Tunable.S40P03.FailureMitigation%}% less progress.

perks.name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
perks.description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation. When the Invocation is completed:
    - All Generators gain {Tunable.S41P01.GeneratorChargeReduction} permanent charges. - You become injured. - You gain {Keyword.Broken}.
Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.

perks.name: Strength in Shadows
perks.description:
While in the Basement:
    - You can heal yourself, but {Tunable.S41P02.SelfHealSpeed%}% slower. - Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S41P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Wicked
perks.description:
While in the Basement, you can unhook yourself.

Whenever you are unhooked, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S41P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Mirrored Illusion
perks.description: After repairing {Tunable.S42P01.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Chest, Exit Gate Switch, Generator, or Totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to create a static illusion for {Tunable.S42P01.HuskDuration}s.

perks.name: Bardic Inspiration
perks.description:
While idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to perform, empowering all Survivors within {Tunable.S42P02.PerformanceDistance}m for up to {Tunable.S42P02.PerformanceDuration}s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. Roll a d20:
    - 1 | You scream, but nothing happens. - 2-10 | Basic Skill Checks give +{Tunable.S42P02.LowRollBonus%}% progress. - 11-19 | Basic Skill Checks give +{Tunable.S42P02.MidRollBonus%}% progress. - 20 | Basic Skill Checks give +{Tunable.S42P02.HighRollBonus%}% progress.
If you complete the performance, this effect ends after {Tunable.S42P02.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S42P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Still Sight
perks.description:
After being idle for {Tunable.S42P03.RequiredActivationTime}s, within {Tunable.S42P03.RevealDistance}m, until you start moving:
    - You see the Killer's Aura. - You see the Auras of Chests. - You see the Auras of Generators.

perks.name: Finesse
perks.description:
While healthy, you fast-vault {Tunable.S43P01.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

Whenever you fast-vault, cooldown: {Tunable.S43P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Hardened
perks.description: When you have blessed or cleansed a Totem and unlocked a Chest, whenever you would scream, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S43P02.AuraRevealDuration}s instead.

perks.name: Specialist
perks.description:
Whenever you rummage or unlock a Chest, you earn {Tunable.S43P03.TokensPerChest} Token, up to {Tunable.S43P03.MaxTokens}.

While repairing a Generator, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains {Tunable.S43P03.GenChargesRemoved%}% permanent progress.

perks.name: Eyes of Belmont
perks.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S44P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever you see the Killer's Aura for a duration, it is {Tunable.S44P01.AuraRevealBonusDuration}s longer.

perks.name: Exultation
perks.description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
    - Your item rarity is upgraded to the next tier, if possible. - If the item was upgraded, it recharges {Tunable.S44P02.ItemRecharge%}% Charges.
Cooldown: {Tunable.S44P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Moment of Glory
perks.description:
After you rummage or unlock {Tunable.S44P03.ChestSearchRequired} Chest, while not {Keyword.Broken}, when you become injured, gain {Keyword.Broken}.

After {Tunable.S44P03.TimeToHeal}s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.

perks.name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
perks.description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation. When the Invocation is completed:
    - Whenever the Killer scares a Crow while a Survivor is in their Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S45P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. - You become injured. - You gain {Keyword.Broken}.
Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.

perks.name: Clean Break
perks.description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to gain {Keyword.Broken}.

After {Tunable.S45P02.TimeOfHeal}s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.

perks.name: Shoulder the Burden
perks.description:
Once per trial, while you do not have {Tunable.S45P03.MaxHooksToDeactivate} Hook States and are next to a hooked Survivor, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to unhook them:
    - They lose 1 Hook State. - You gain 1 Hook State. - You scream. - You gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.S45P03.ExposedDuration}s.

perks.name: Do No Harm
perks.description:
While healing another Survivor:
    - For each Hook State they have, you heal {Tunable.S46P01.HealSpeedBonus%}% faster. - Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you gain {Tunable.S46P01.GreatSkillCheckBonus%}% more progress.

perks.name: Duty of Care
perks.description: While healthy, whenever you take a protection hit, other Survivors within {Tunable.S46P02.MaxDistance}m gain {Tunable.S46P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S46P02.HasteDuration}s.

perks.name: Rapid Response
perks.description:
Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, you gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S46P03.ExhaustionDuration}s.

Whenever you gain {Keyword.Exhausted}, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S46P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
perks.description:
After you rummage or unlock {Tunable.S47P01.ChestsRequired} Chest, while next to a Broken Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} for {Tunable.S47P01.InteractionDuration}s to create a Fragile Pallet.

Within {Tunable.S47P01.BrokenPalletsRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of Broken Pallets.

perks.name: Come and Get Me!
perks.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, while crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to have injured and downed Survivors within {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDistance}m:
    - Make no Grunts of Pain for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s. - Leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s. - Leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.
You scream, then the Killer sees your Aura for {Tunable.S47P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
perks.description:
While injured, whenever another Survivor within {Tunable.S47P03.RequiredDistance}m of you blinds or Pallet-stuns the Killer, for {Tunable.S47P03.Duration}s:
    - You make no Grunts of Pain. - You leave no Pools of Blood. - You leave no Scratch Marks.

perks.name: Conviction
perks.description:
After you finish healing {Tunable.S48P01.RequiredHealthStates} other Survivor, while downed with at least {Tunable.S48P01.RecoverProgressNeeded%}% recovery, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to recover instantly.

You gain {Keyword.Broken}, then, after {Tunable.S48P01.EffectDuration}s, you are downed instantly.

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.description: After hiding for {Tunable.S48P02.ActivationTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, when you fast-vault, once per trial, stun the Killer for {Tunable.S48P02.StunDuration}s if they are within {Tunable.S48P02.StunRange}m.

perks.name: Teamwork: Throw Down
perks.description:
Whenever you blind or Pallet-stun the Killer, for {Tunable.S48P03.EffectDuration}s, other injured Survivors within {Tunable.S48P03.EffectDistance}m:
    - Gain {Keyword.Endurance}. - See the Killer's Aura.

perks.name: Road Life
perks.description:
While injured, not {Keyword.Broken} and repairing a Generator:
    - Whenever you hit a basic great Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S49P01.TokenPerSkillCheck} Token. - Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose {Tunable.S49P01.TokensLostOnSkillCheckFail} token.
When you have {Tunable.S49P01.MaxTokens} Tokens, spend all Tokens to heal {Tunable.S49P01.HealingSpeedIncrease%}% faster until you stop healing.

perks.name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
perks.description:
While idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to perform, empowering all Survivors within {Tunable.S49P02.PerformanceDistance}m for up to {Tunable.S49P02.PerformanceDuration}s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. You get special Skill Checks during that time: while healing or repairing, basic Skill Checks are {Tunable.S49P02.SkillCheckIncrease%}% more likely to appear.

If you complete the performance, the effect ends after {Tunable.S49P02.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S49P02.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: Ghost Notes
perks.description:
While you have {Keyword.Exhausted}, your Scratch Marks disappear {Tunable.S49P03.ScratchmarksTimeReduction%}% faster.

You lose {Keyword.Exhausted} {Tunable.S49P03.CooldownReduction%}% faster.

perks.name: Bada Bada Boom
perks.description:
After repairing {Tunable.S50P01.RequiredGeneratorProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Window, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S50P01.TrapDuration}s. All Survivors see that Window's Aura for that time.

When the Killer vaults that Window, the trap explodes and they gain {Tunable.S50P01.TrapHinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.S50P01.HinderDuration}s.

perks.name: Change of Plan
perks.description:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S50P02.StartingTokens} Tokens.

While hiding in a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} and spend 1 Token to transform your Toolbox and add-ons into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with {Tunable.S50P02.RecoveredCharges%}% Charges and random add-ons of the same rarity.

perks.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
perks.description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, good basic Skill Check zones are {Tunable.S50P03.SuccessZoneIncreasePerSurvivor%}% bigger.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair {Tunable.S50P03.RepairBonus%}% faster.

perks.name: Extrasensory Perception
perks.description:
After crouching for {Tunable.S51P01.CrouchActivationTime}s:
    - You see Auras in an expanding radius up to {Tunable.S51P01.MaxDistance}m. - You gain {Keyword.Elusive}. - You gain {Keyword.Oblivious}.
When you stop crouching, or after {Tunable.S51P01.MaxActiveListeningUptime}s, cooldown: {Tunable.S51P01.Cooldown}s.

perks.name: We See You
perks.description:
Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you earn {Tunable.S51P02.TokensPerReveal} Token. Cooldown: {Tunable.S51P02.CooldownBetweenTokens}s.

When you have {Tunable.S51P02.MaxTokens} Tokens, spend them all. Then, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S51P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

perks.name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
perks.description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range of Generator repair noises is {Tunable.S51P03.NoiseReductionPerSurvivor%}% smaller.
