addons.name: Party Bottle
addons.description:
Be the life of the party!

Party Bottles emit confetti when they break, in addition to their usual gas effect.Hitting a Survivor directly with a Party Bottle interrupts actions as usual, and awards 100 Devious Bloodpoints.

addons.name: Smelly Inner Soles
addons.description:
A moldy inner sole which gives much comfort to tired feet.

Increases movement speed while reloading bottles by 15%.

addons.name: Fingerless Parade Gloves
addons.description:
Part of the standard Clown apparel; the cut fingers allow for dexterous manipulations.

Increases bottle throw speed by 25%.Decreases bottle throw angle by 15 degrees.

addons.name: Thick Cork Stopper
addons.description:
A sturdy cork, fitting The Afterpiece Tonic bottles perfectly.

Decreases reload time by 0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Solvent Jug
addons.description:
A volatile chemical compound that irritates the respiratory tract, but increases absorption of The Afterpiece Antidote.

Increases duration of Invigoration by 1 second.

addons.name: Kerosene Can
addons.description:
A thin and clear combustible liquid which numbs the mind when inhaled.

Intoxication inflicts Blindness for 30 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

addons.name: Sticky Soda Bottle
addons.description:
It's sugary sweet, with only a little blood on the label.

Increases The Clown's Invigoration by 2%.

addons.name: Starling Feather
addons.description:
A black feather with an emerald sheen, very soft to the touch.

Decreases bottle throw cooldown by 50%.

addons.name: VHS Porn
addons.description:
An all time classic. You won't see things quite the same again.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds by 10%.

addons.name: Spirit of Hartshorn
addons.description:
A pungent chemical compound consisting of ammonia. One whiff is enough to jolt even the most sluggish of minds.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Antidote gas clouds by 20%.

addons.name: Sulfuric Acid Vial
addons.description:
An odorless syrupy liquid which is highly corrosive.

Intoxication inflicts Mangled on injured Survivors for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Flask of Bleach
addons.description:
A potent chemical which causes irritation, burn and lungs damage.

Increases the Hindered penalty from Intoxication by an additional 2%.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

addons.name: Bottle of Chloroform
addons.description:
A sweet-smelling organic compound with strong anesthetic capabilities.

Increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds by 20%.

addons.name: Garish Makeup Kit
addons.description:
Some for the face and some for the Antidote. The unknown compound intensifies the Antidote's effects.

Increases the duration of Invigoration by 2 seconds.

addons.name: Cheap Gin Bottle
addons.description:
When the night was rough and the day is rougher, a little hair of the dog will give you a boost.

Increases The Clown's Invigoration by 3%.

addons.name: Ether 15 vol%
addons.description:
A highly volatile organic compound, toxic at this concentration.

Increases the duration of Intoxication by 0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Cigar Box
addons.description:
A grim and incomplete collection of fingers. Fills The Clown with longing and focuses his chemical crafting abilities.

While The Clown or a Survivor is Invigorated, they see all other Survivor and Killer auras within 6 meters.

addons.name: Tattoo's Middle Finger
addons.description:
The prized middle finger of a large tattooed man. Has a faint taste of machinery oil.

Auras of Intoxicated or Invigorated Survivors are revealed to you for 6 seconds.

addons.name: @#Addon_GasBomb_19a_NAME
addons.description: @#Addon_GasBomb_19a_DESC

addons.name: Redhead's Pinky Finger
addons.description:
The prized pinky of a redhead. Faintly fragrant. Tastes of potpourri and varnish.

Direct hits by a bottle of Afterpiece Tonic inflict Exposed until Intoxication ends.Sets maximum number of carried bottles to 1.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

addons.name: @#Addon_GasBomb_20a_NAME
addons.description: @#Addon_GasBomb_20a_DESC

addons.name: @#Addon_GasBomb_20b_NAME
addons.description: @#Addon_GasBomb_20b_DESC

addons.name: Cheap Cologne
addons.description:
Dollar store cologne with a pungent scent of rubbing alcohol. Worn by Ghost Face to make his presence known. Reserved for impromptu visits.

Increases Marked duration by 10 seconds.

addons.name: Chewed Pen
addons.description:
Blue pen with a chewed cap that holds traces of Danny’s DNA. Incriminating evidence that was never found.

Survivors that are in the dying state take 3 seconds to reveal The Ghost Face.

addons.name: Driver's License
addons.description:
A driver’s license revealing Olsen’s true identity: Danny Johnson.

When Marking a Survivor repairing a Generator, the Generator explodes and loses 20% progress.The affected Generator becomes blocked for 15 seconds.When Marking multiple Survivors at the same time, the loss of progress only applies once.

addons.name: Drop-Leg Knife Sheath
addons.description:
Sheath allowing a full motion range: ideal to inflict quick and powerful wounds while moving freely. Stolen from a patrol officer the night Danny left Philadelphia.

The Ghost Face gains 10% movement speed for 5 seconds after Marking a Survivor.

addons.name: Headline Cutouts
addons.description:
Cutouts of articles covering unsolved murder cases from Utah to Pennsylvania. While Ghost Face only authored some of the headlines, he committed all the murders.

Compiling your success makes you proud and boosts your confidence.

Increases movement speed while stalking by 40%.

addons.name: Knife Belt Clip
addons.description:
Perfect belt clip to scout carry your blade discreetly. No one knows what you’re planning to do tonight.

Reduces the Terror Radius by 12 meters while crouching.

addons.name: Lasting Perfume
addons.description:
An overpowering musky fragrance worn by Ghost Face to announce his presence. Reserved for victims he planned to write about.

Survivors that are on a hook take 3 seconds to reveal The Ghost Face.

addons.name: Leather Knife Sheath
addons.description:
Quiet and flexible sheath to carry your blade. Movement is easier when things are fastened into place.

Increases crouched movement speed by 10%.

addons.name: Marked Map
addons.description:
The annotated map of Northern Roseville, Florida. Each X represents a victim of The Ghost Face. Mapping out your targets allows you to roam the streets undetected.

Increases duration of Killer Instinct after being revealed by 2 seconds.

addons.name: Night Vision Monocular
addons.description:
Night vision lens enabling sharp photos even when shrouded in darkness. Ideal for discreet, impromptu visits late at night.

A Survivor that reveals The Ghost Face is inflicted with Exhausted for 10 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

addons.name: Olsen's Address Book
addons.description:
Filled in blunt, blue crabbed writing. All the Roseville murder victims are listed there, along with their phone number and address.

Survivors that are Marked reveal their auras for 5 seconds when performing rushed actions.

addons.name: Olsen’s Journal
addons.description:
A spiral notebook filled with stained, handwritten entries. The journal details different equipment used to stalk victims.

A Survivor that is Marked is inflicted with Oblivious until the Mark expires.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

addons.name: Olsen’s Wallet
addons.description:
Olsen’s wallet holds thirty dollars in cash, a video club membership card, and a folded picture of Olsen’s first Roseville victim. Carrying incriminating evidence boosts your excitement and resolve.

Whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, instantly recharge Night Shroud.

addons.name: Outdoor Security Camera
addons.description:
A small surveillance camera that filmed Ghost Face breaking into a house on Belleview Road in Northern Roseville. The camera was positioned at the perfect angle to catch a glimpse of Ghost Face without providing any real clues to the police.

The auras of all Survivors are revealed for 7 seconds when a Marked Survivor is put into the dying state.

addons.name: “Philly”
addons.description:
Stolen camera from a victim of Olsen’s in Philadelphia, where he worked before. The film inside captured his last night in the city.

Decreases time required to Mark a Survivor by 10%.

addons.name: Cinch Straps
addons.description:
Black straps that keep everything in place while on the prowl.

Night Shroud remains active after a failed basic attack.

addons.name: Telephoto Lens
addons.description:
A manual focus lens to take pictures from afar without being noticed.

A Survivor that reveals The Ghost Face is inflicted with Oblivious for 60 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

addons.name: “Ghost Face Caught on Tape”
addons.description:
Tape obtained by Olsen to write an article that terrorized Roseville.

Instantly recharges Night Shroud after a successful basic attack that puts a Survivor into the dying state.

addons.name: Victim’s Detailed Routine
addons.description:
A ripped page outlining the weekly routine of Olsen's first victim in Roseville. Compiling your victim's habits allows you to anticipate and counter their next move.

After being Marked, Survivors are inflicted with Exhausted for 5 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

addons.name: Walleye's Matchbook
addons.description:
A sheet of matches from Walleye's, a small bar in Northern Roseville. A victim’s phone number is scribbled in blue. One of the incriminating pieces of evidence found.

Decreases Night Shroud recovery time by 2 seconds.

addons.name: Barbed Wire
addons.description:
Pliable American made steel lined with sharp barbs. Despite its simplicity, Caleb found it could be wrapped around a spear to increase its viciousness.

Increases Survivor mend time by 3.5 seconds.

addons.name: Bayshore’s Cigar
addons.description:
A quality cigar, plucked from the jacket of Caleb’s boss while he wailed over the spear lodged in his abdomen.

Decreases the stun duration when Survivors break free by 0.75 second.

addons.name: Bayshore’s Gold Tooth
addons.description:
A golden tooth torn from Henry Bayshore as he screamed for mercy, hours before he was finished off.

Increases The Redeemer's reeling speed by 5%.

addons.name: Chewing Tobacco
addons.description:
A can of clipped and sweetened tobacco leaves lifted from a gutted body in Glenvale. Stimulates the nervous system.

Decreases the stun duration when Survivors break free by 0.25 seconds.

addons.name: Gold Creek Whiskey
addons.description:
Warm comfort in a bottle that quelled Caleb’s anger and slowed his step.

Decreases Terror Radius by 8 meters while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

addons.name: Hellshire Iron
addons.description:
The Hellshire Gang’s branding iron. Despite folklore, it never made its mark on new initiates, instead having been used to brand particularly quarrelsome bounties.

When a Survivor is speared, gain Undetectable. The effect persists for 10 seconds after the Survivor is no longer speared.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius and Red Stain.

addons.name: Honey Locust Thorns
addons.description:
Angered with a bounty who fled twice before, Caleb twisted thorn branches onto a spear and let it loose.

Breaking free from the spear inflicts Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Iridescent Coin
addons.description:
A glass-like coin molded from The Fog itself. Payment to the bounty hunter for services rendered.

Survivors speared from at least 12 meters away are inflicted with Exposed for as long as they remain speared.

Exposed survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

addons.name: Jaw Smasher
addons.description:
The bullet that ripped through Caleb’s jaw during a frenzied shootout. It brings back a burning desire for revenge.

Increases movement speed by 1.5% while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

addons.name: Marshal's Badge
addons.description:
A silver badge taken from the corpse of a lawman in Arizona Territory who interfered with the Hellshire Gang’s bounties.

Decreases Terror Radius by 4 meters while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

addons.name: Modified Ammo Belt
addons.description:
An old ammo belt Caleb altered for his specialized weaponry. Still holds the fine red dirt of the Arizona Territory desert.

Decreases The Redeemer's reload time by 0.25 seconds.

addons.name: Poison Oak Leaves
addons.description:
An ordinary looking plant, Caleb found that spears coated in its oil caused unbearable blistering around wounds.

Increases Survivor mend time by 1.5 seconds.

addons.name: Prison Chain
addons.description:
A thick, heavy chain that once held a steel ball and latched to Caleb’s ankle. It’s been repurposed to hook onto a spear.

Increases time required for a Survivor to break free from a spear by 10%.

addons.name: Rickety Chain
addons.description:
Weak steel links first used on Caleb's prototype Speargun. Despite the chain's failings, it holds sentimental value.

Grants 50% bonus Bloodpoints for Speared score events.Survivors break free 33% faster.

addons.name: Rusted Spike
addons.description:
A railroad spike that Caleb fastened to the front of the Speargun during a moment of morbid curiosity. The dull tip prevents it from cleanly piercing its target.

Hitting a Survivor with The Redeemer while they are being reeled in inflicts Mangled for 60 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Snake Oil
addons.description:
A tincture of oils and extracts purchased from a travelling salesman. Purported to cure all that ails you.

Increases The Redeemer's reeling speed by 2.5%.

addons.name: Spit Polish Rag
addons.description:
A grimy piece of burlap. Spit and elbow grease was enough to wipe down the speargun in the heat of a shootout.

Decreases The Redeemer's miss cooldown by 0.25 seconds.

addons.name: Tin Oil Can
addons.description:
A can holding a small amount of oil to reduce friction in machinery. Early models of the Speargun were notorious for jamming, and oil had to be readily available.

Decreases The Redeemer's miss cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Wanted Poster
addons.description:
The yellowed remains of a wanted poster for Mason Kelly. Kept Caleb focused on the hunt.

Increases movement speed by 3% while aiming down The Redeemer's sights.

addons.name: Warden’s Keys
addons.description:
The dull jangle of the keys evokes a furious memory within Caleb.

Decreases The Redeemer's reload time by 0.35 seconds.

addons.name: Amanita Toxin
addons.description:
A toxin applied to the Hatchets' blade. The Amanita mushrooms' toxin numbs the mind.

Hatchets inflict Blindness for 60 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

addons.name: Bandaged Haft
addons.description:
First-aid bandages securely rolled and attached to the Hatchets' haft.

Decreases Hatchet throw cooldown by 10%.

addons.name: Begrimed Head
addons.description:
These Hatchets' heads are stained with a foul substance that afflict anyone it touches with debilities.

Hit target suffers from the Mangled and Hemorrhage status effects for 80 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Yellowed Cloth
addons.description:
A simple scrap of material to tend to blisters and wipe the puss away.

Increases thrown hatchet speed by 10%.

addons.name: Coarse Stone
addons.description:
This stone is too coarse to do any good. A blade damaged by it inflicts awful open wounds.

Hitting a target increases the volume of their grunts of pain by 50% until healed.

addons.name: Deerskin Gloves
addons.description:
Cured leather gloves that protect the hands and give a sure grip.

Decreases time required to reload Hatchets at a locker by 20%.

addons.name: Weighted Head
addons.description:
An oddly weighted hatchet head, crafted to deliver a hard blow to its target. It requires a wielder with a strong arm.

Hatchets inflict Incapacitated for 10 seconds.

Incapacitated prevents Survivors from healing, repairing, sabotaging, cleansing, blessing, mending, or using items.

addons.name: Flower Babushka
addons.description:
A clean and colorful kerchief adorned with a flower pattern. This memory of a lost little one fills the Huntress with rage and focus.

Decreases time required to wind up a Hatchet throw by 10%.

addons.name: Glowing Concoction
addons.description:
An otherworldly concoction that faintly glows a foreboding light.

Reveals the auras of Survivors hit by Hatchets for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Infantry Belt
addons.description:
A sturdy utility belt pillaged from a soldier. He was quick in combat, but she was quicker.

Hatchet hits grant 3% Haste for 5 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

addons.name: Iridescent Head
addons.description:
A glass-like Hatchet head molded from The Fog Itself. The blade is warm and reverberating with The Entity's power.

Successful Hatchet hits immediately put healthy Survivors into the dying state.Sets maximum number of carried Hatchets to 1.

addons.name: Leather Loop
addons.description:
The right tool in the right hands is key to a successful hunt.

Hatchet hits grant 2% Haste for 5 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

addons.name: Manna Grass Braid
addons.description:
A circular decorative braid made from manna grass. This memory of a lost little one fills the Huntress with rage and focus.

Decreases time required to wind up a Hatchet throw by 5%.

addons.name: Oak Haft
addons.description:
A polished haft which allows for a quick and sly manipulation of the deadly tool.

Decreases Hatchet throw cooldown by 20%.

addons.name: Soldier's Puttee
addons.description:
A wrap taken from a dead soldier, it provides protection and support to the ankle and lower leg.

The Huntress moves 4.6 m/s when she has no Hatchets.

addons.name: Rusty Head
addons.description:
These Hatchets' heads are covered with crusty and volatile rust spots that makes injuries particularly difficult to heal.

Hatchets inflict Mangled for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Shiny Pin
addons.description:
A copper pin defaced beyond recognition yet polished to a high sheen. Pillaged from a particularly difficult prey.

Increases The Huntress' movement speed by 5% while aiming or throwing a Hatchet.

addons.name: Venomous Concoction
addons.description:
A toxic concoction applied to the Hatchets' blade. The murky concoction is mainly composed of Berus snake venom which gives it fatiguing capabilities.

Hatchets inflict Exhausted for 5 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.

addons.name: Wooden Fox
addons.description:
Roughly carved, this fox statuette is no more than a few inches. A reminder that stealth and cunning is as effective as raw power.

Grants Undetectable for 30 seconds after reloading.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

addons.name: Rose Root
addons.description:
Dried petals that relieve symptoms of fatigue and overexertion when brewed in a tea.

Increases thrown Hatchet speed by 20%.

addons.name: Filthy Slippers
addons.description:
Max sometimes struggled to hear his mother’s footfalls.

After maintaining a Chainsaw Sprint for 2 seconds, grants Undetectable until the Chainsaw Sprint ends.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

addons.name: Cat Figurine
addons.description:
A wooden figure that had caught young Victor's eye. He shrieked until his mother stole it from the market, nearly blowing their cover.

Displays the target location of a Pounce.

addons.name: Rusted Needle
addons.description:
A needle Madeleine used to sew up her children’s tattered clothes.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Hemorrhage until healed.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured Survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Sewer Sludge
addons.description:
A disgusting, sticky mixture that covered the Deshayes during an escape attempt through the city sewers.

Increases time to crush Victor when attached by 2 seconds.

addons.name: Madeleine’s Scarf
addons.description:
A cloth Madeleine wore shortly before her death. The Twins kept it as a memento.

Increases Victor's movement speed by 0.3 m/s.

addons.name: Stale Biscuit
addons.description:
A hard, unleavened biscuit that Madeleine stole from a town’s market. It wasn’t much, but it was better than most meals.

Decreases Pounce cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

addons.name: Weighty Rattle
addons.description:
A shoddily carved rattle that Victor cried over until his mother stole it for him. It’s entirely too heavy to be trusted to a child.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Broken for 20 seconds.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.

addons.name: Forest Stew
addons.description:
A stew of foraged vegetables mixed with moss and bark to create a false sense of fullness.

Increases Victor's movement speed by 0.6 m/s.

addons.name: Spinning Top
addons.description:
A wooden top shared between The Twins, though Victor wanted it for his own. He learned he could get what he wanted if he clung tightly and screamed.

Victor's Pounce causes Survivors to drop their carried Survivor items.

addons.name: Drop of Perfume
addons.description:
One of the few luxuries Madeleine escaped her past life with. It has a pleasant, disarming scent.

Survivors in Victor's alert range while he is dormant are inflicted with Oblivious.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

addons.name: Victor’s Soldier
addons.description:
A toy soldier Victor clung to when scared. Something about it evoked jealousy in Charlotte.

Crushing Victor while he is dormant reveals the Survivor's aura for 6 seconds.

addons.name: Silencing Cloth
addons.description:
A coarse strip of cloth that a five-year-old Charlotte would put in her mouth. Stopped her from screaming when witch hunters were nearby.

Charlotte gains Undetectable for 20 seconds after waking from her dormant state.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

addons.name: Tiny Fingernail
addons.description:
Charlotte had many ways to mourn Victor’s death. As the fingernails loosened from his rotting hands, she took one in remembrance.

Decreases Victor's Unbind time by 33%.

addons.name: Iridescent Pendant
addons.description:
A glass-like pendant molded from The Fog itself. There’s a portrait of Madeleine Deshayes upon it, though something about her depiction seems unsettling.

Crushing Victor while he is dormant inflicts Exposed for 45 seconds.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

addons.name: Soured Milk
addons.description:
A metal bottle filled with milk that has since soured. Loud as Victor could be, he quieted down when presented with his meal.

Increases Victor's alert range by 2 meters.

addons.name: Toy Sword
addons.description:
A miniscule toy sword, only a few inches long. Holding it brought out a violent enthusiasm in Victor.

Decreases Pounce charge time by 10%.

addons.name: Cat’s Eye
addons.description:
An eyeball that belonged to a cat eaten by the starving Deshayes’ family. Victor hid it from his mother, using it as a toy.

Victor becomes silent while Pounce is fully charged.

addons.name: Madeleine’s Glove
addons.description:
A glove once owned by The Twins’ mother. During desperate times, it was held over Victor’s mouth to keep him from making a peep.

Increases Victor's alert range by 4 meters.

addons.name: Bloody Black Hood
addons.description:
A hood from one of the men that hunted Charlotte. Soon, he became the prey.

Decreases Charlotte's waking time by 0.5 seconds.

addons.name: Ceremonial Candelabrum
addons.description:
The candelabrum that Victor tipped over, causing his captors to burn. A symbol of his tenacity.

Increases time to crush Victor when he is dormant by 0.2 seconds.

addons.name: Baby Teeth
addons.description:
Two teeth that Victor lost long ago. They’re unusually sharp.

Crushing Victor when attached inflicts Blindness for 30 seconds.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

addons.name: Damaged Syringe
addons.description: Medical equipment that fared poorly during the chaos that overwhelmed Raccoon City.Increases time it takes Survivors to use a Vaccine by 5 seconds.

addons.name: Tyrant Gore
addons.description: A damaged sample from a T-002 Tyrant that died in combat. There are signs of severe burns.Increases mutation rate when destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike by 75%.Decreases zombie respawn time by 7.5 seconds.

addons.name: Serotonin Injector
addons.description:
A hormone that slightly relaxes the user for when stealth is required.Grants Undetectable for 15 seconds when a zombie is destroyed.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

addons.name: T-Virus Sample
addons.description: A sample of the T-Virus developed by Umbrella Corporation, it causes extreme mutations and brain damage in its subjects.Increases mutation rate when destroying zombies with Tentacle Strike by 100%.

addons.name: Plant 43 Vines
addons.description: The tangled remnants of a plant infected with the T-Virus, it killed one of the researchers who developed it.Increases time required for Survivors to open Supply Cases by 4 seconds.

addons.name: Licker Tongue
addons.description:
A sticky prehensile tongue that easily wraps around anything it touches.Survivors are Hindered for an extra 1 second after being Contaminated.

Hindered reduces Survivor movement speed.

addons.name: NE-α Parasite
addons.description:
A parasite used in the development of Nemesis T-Types, it’s capable of hijacking its host’s brain.Becoming Contaminated inflicts Oblivious for 60 seconds, or until the Survivor receives a Vaccine.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

addons.name: Jill’s Sandwich
addons.description: It’s tragically squished and dripping with blood from a recent battle. Despite that, it has a delicious aroma that can’t be missed.Reveals a Survivor's aura for 12 seconds after they unlock a Supply Case.

addons.name: Broken Recovery Coin
addons.description: A coin depicting a bird framed by a laurel wreath. It’s broken in half.Removes 1 Supply Case from the trial.

addons.name: Depleted Ink Ribbon
addons.description: Who will save them now? There’s something about this ink ribbon being dry that energizes zombies.Decreases zombie respawn time by 5 seconds.Increases zombie movement speed by 50%.Any zombies destroyed after all generators are repaired will respawn in an exit area.

addons.name: Shattered S.T.A.R.S. Badge
addons.description: A symbol of hope for Raccoon City, utterly destroyed.Increases Zombie movement speed by 150% for 60 seconds after a generator is repaired.

addons.name: Brian’s Intestine
addons.description: The small intestine of Brian Irons, chief of the RPD. It's an appetizing sight for zombies.Increases zombie movement speed by 25%.

addons.name: Iridescent Umbrella Badge
addons.description:
A glass-like badge molded from The Fog itself. It represents a corporation that pushed far beyond ethical and humane science.Survivors are inflicted with Exposed for 60 seconds when using a Vaccine.

Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

addons.name: Visitor Wristband
addons.description: An electronic Umbrella wristband for visitors to the facility. It also doubles as a tracking device.Increases zombie detection range by 2 meters and field of view by 10 degrees.

addons.name: S.T.A.R.S. Field Combat Manual
addons.description: A manual of compiled S.T.A.R.S. close-range combat knowledge. Edited by Chris Redfield.Zombies’ auras turn yellow for 6 seconds after hitting a Survivor.

addons.name: Marvin’s Blood
addons.description: The contaminated blood of a Raccoon City police officer.Increases mutation rate when hitting Survivors with Tentacle Strike by 16% for uncontaminated Survivors and by 50% for contaminated Survivors.

addons.name: Adrenaline Injector
addons.description: A hormone that heightens senses and prepares the body to fight.Increases length of Killer Instinct when Survivors use a Vaccine by 3 seconds.

addons.name: Mikhail’s Eye

addons.name: "Order" - Class II
addons.description:
A high stimulus ECT procedure, part of a patient daily routine at the Léry's Memorial Institute. Can cause a state of moderate confusion in the patient.

Decreases Static Blast cooldown by 2.5 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Order:

Broken pallets may appear to be replaced with illusionary pallets that persist until approached.A new illusionary pallet is generated at the location of a random broken pallet every 20 seconds.The Doctor sees the auras of illusionary pallets.

addons.name: "Order" - Carter's Notes
addons.description:
An experimental version of the ECT procedure, annotated by Doctor Herman Carter himself. The long, constant stimulus leaves the patient in a state of severe confusion.

Decreases Static Blast cooldown by 3 seconds.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Order:

Broken pallets may appear to be replaced with illusionary pallets that persist until approached.A new illusionary pallet is generated at the location of a random broken pallet every 20 seconds.The Doctor sees the auras of illusionary pallets.

addons.name: Polished Electrode
addons.description:
A like-new electrode, standard equipment to conduct electroconvulsive treatments.

Increases the range of Shock Therapy by 3 meters.

addons.name: "Restraint" - Class II
addons.description:
An experimental ECT procedure developed within The Fog. Uses a wavelength that links the patient's and Doctor's minds. This procedure is known to cause mild cases of hallucinations in the patient.

Reveals Survivors' auras for 1 second when their Madness level increases.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Restraint:

Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.Allows The Doctor to see the auras of hallucinations at any level of Madness.

addons.name: "Restraint" - Class III
addons.description:
An experimental ECT procedure developed within The Fog. Uses a high stimulus wavelength to link the patient's and Doctor's minds. This procedure is known to cause serious cases of hallucinations in the patient.

Reveals Survivors' auras for 2 seconds when their Madness level increases.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Restraint:

Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.Allows The Doctor to see the auras of hallucinations at any level of Madness.

addons.name: "Restraint" - Carter's Notes
addons.description:
An experimental ECT procedure developed within The Fog, crudely annotated. Uses an unbearable stimulus wavelength to link the patient's and Doctor's minds. This procedure is known to cause severe cases of hallucinations in the patient.

Reveals Survivors' auras for 3 seconds when their Madness level increases.

Survivors with Madness suffer from the Affliction of Restraint:

Increases the duration of illusionary Doctor hallucinations by 6 seconds.Allows The Doctor to see the auras of hallucinations at any level of Madness.

addons.name: Interview Tape
addons.description:
A compact cassette from Project Awakening containing an un-edited interview of a victim. Opens The Doctor's mind to alternate treatment methods.

Shock Therapy special ability changes from a cone to a beam with a 24 meter range and a 2 meter width.

addons.name: Blonde Hair
addons.description:
A single slightly wavy blond hair.

Scratch marks and pools of blood last 100% longer in Stalker Mode.

addons.name: Boyfriend's Memo
addons.description:
A "romantic", if slightly sleazy, note left around to draw the attention of a female lover.

Increases Stalk range by 8 meters.

addons.name: Dead Rabbit
addons.description:
A grey rabbit which has been opened from neck to tail.

Decreases Terror Radius in Pursuer Mode by 25%.Increases Terror Radius in Evil Incarnate mode by 25%.

addons.name: Fragrant Tuft of Hair
addons.description:
A tuft of blond hair which was forcefully torn off someone's scalp. Releases hints of feminine floral fragrance.

In Evil Incarnate Mode:

Survivors are Exposed.Lunge range is increased by 50%.Slaughtering Strike cannot be used.

Exposed survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.

addons.name: Glass Fragment
addons.description:
A tiny piece of tinted glass, probably from a broken object. It is impossible to determine its origin.

Increases the movement speed of Slaughtering Strike by 5%.Decreases the charge speed of Slaughtering Strike by 10%.

addons.name: Hair Bow
addons.description:
A blue tartan ribbon used to tie hair.

Increases the duration of Evil Incarnate by 20 seconds.Decreases the Stalk Meter fill rate by 20%.

addons.name: Hair Brush
addons.description:
A nylon bristle brush used to add body and softness to hair.

When Evil Incarnate activates, the next pallet break is 50% faster.

addons.name: Jewelry
addons.description:
A large necklace made of beads and inexpensive metals. One of Judith's favorites.

Increases the Stalk Meter fill rate on stationary Survivors by 10%.

addons.name: Jewelry Box
addons.description:
A barren wooden box in which vanity items were once stored.

Increases the Stalk Meter fill rate by 30%.Decreases stalk range by 16 meters.

addons.name: J.Myers Memorial
addons.description:
A glossy page ripped from the '65 Haddonfield High School yearbook, one dedicated to the memory of Judith Myers.

Increases pickup and hook speeds by 40% in Evil Incarnate Mode.

addons.name: Judith's Journal
addons.description:
A journal identified as owned by Judith M. Myers. Most of the pages are defaced with frightening and disturbing drawings.

Increases the Stalk Meter fill rate on the Obsession by 40%.

addons.name: Judith's Tombstone
addons.description:
A large and heavy granite tombstone stolen from Mt. Sinclair cemetery, belonging to Judith Myers.

Hooking a Survivor during Evil Incarnate refreshes its duration.Limits the duration of Evil Incarnate to 40 seconds.

addons.name: Lock of Hair
addons.description:
A cut lock of blond hair bunched with a black elastic.

While Evil Incarnate is active, hold the Ability button to end it prematurely and retain 50% of the remaining duration as Stalk progress.

addons.name: Memorial Flower
addons.description:
A partially faded and dried pink larkspur picked up from a gravestone.

Increases movement speed in Stalker Mode to 4.4 m/s.

addons.name: Mirror Shard
addons.description:
A large and sharp piece of a broken mirror.

Increases the base duration of Slaughtering Strike by 0.25 seconds.Decreases the charge speed of Slaughtering Strike by 25%.

addons.name: Reflective Fragment
addons.description:
A tiny piece of a highly reflective material most probably from a broken mirror.

Hitting a Survivor with Slaughtering Strike adds 20 seconds to Evil Incarnate's duration.Slaughtering Strike only deals a single health state of damage.

addons.name: Scratched Mirror
addons.description:
A standing portable vanity mirror which has been violently scratched with a sharp metallic object.

Reveal the auras of Survivors within 32 meters while stalking.Cannot leave Stalker Mode.Score events for hits grant 100% more Brutality and 200% more Deviousness Bloodpoints.

addons.name: Tacky Earrings
addons.description:
A very cheap piece of jewelry made from plastic. Painted to resemble precious material.

Increases movement speed while stalking by 20%.

addons.name: Tombstone Piece
addons.description:
A fist-sized granite piece taken from a broken tombstone.

When Evil Incarnate activates, you become Undetectable for 20 seconds.

addons.name: Vanity Mirror
addons.description:
A standing portable vanity mirror in perfect condition except for a fine layer of dust and face powder covering it.

When Evil Incarnate ends, you see the auras of all Survivors for 4 seconds.

addons.name: Videotape Copy
addons.description:
A copy of the deadly videotape imprinted upon by Sadako. It dampens the desire for vengeance.

Increases the range at which Survivors gain Condemned from Projection by 2 meters

addons.name: Old Newspaper
addons.description:
It tells of a local woman who predicted a volcanic eruption, evidence used to initially find Sadako.

Increases the Manifestation invisibility duration by 33%.

addons.name: Cabin Sign
addons.description:
The cabin where both Tomoko and Reiko watched the tape. Carries the memory of those first curses.

Decreases the time it takes for a TV to turn on after Projection by 4.5 seconds.

addons.name: Mother's Mirror
addons.description:
A mirror from Sadako's mother's house. A reminder of what Sadako has lost.

Increases the Manifestation intermittent visibility duration by 2 seconds.

addons.name: Reiko's Watch
addons.description:
The watch that Reiko left her son Yoichi. A distracting and constant reminder of one’s impending doom.

Increases the invisibility duration while Demanifested by 25%.

addons.name: Sea-Soaked Cloth
addons.description:
The hood worn by the mysterious figure in the tape. Makes those near it unable to trust what they see.

While Survivors are within 8 meters of a powered TV, they are afflicted with the Blindness status effect. This effect lingers for 7 seconds after the TV is turned off.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

addons.name: Clump of Hair
addons.description:
Once beautiful and long, Sadako now hides behind her ragged, matted locks.

Decreases the range at which The Onryō is visible while Demanifested by 6 meters.

addons.name: Well Stone
addons.description:
A piece of the well where Sadako was trapped, an image burned into the mind of all those who have watched the tape.

Decreases the time it takes for a TV to turn on after being turned off by a Survivor by 7 seconds.

addons.name: Yoichi's Fishing Net
addons.description:
The net Yoichi used while fishing with his grandfather. A reminder that death comes to us all.

Survivors with at least 4 stacks of Condemned suffer from Blindness.

Blindness prevents Survivors from seeing auras.

addons.name: Rickety Pinwheel
addons.description:
A pinwheel found in the caves of Izu Oshima. It spins even when there is no wind, disorienting those who see or hear it.

While Survivors are within 8 meters of a powered TV, they are afflicted with the Oblivious status effect. This effect lingers for 7 seconds after the TV is turned off.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

addons.name: Well Water
addons.description:
Water from the well where Sadako was left to die. Murky and black, it obscures everything around it.

Increases the duration of the Undetectable status effect by 2 seconds when Manifesting by any means.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.

addons.name: Ring Drawing
addons.description:
A drawing of the view from inside the well, as drawn by a young Yoichi. Helping those cursed by the tape can only bring misfortune.

When hooking a Survivor carrying a tape, other Survivors gain 1 Condemned stack.

addons.name: Bloody Fingernails
addons.description:
Sadako's bloody fingernails, lost as she tried to claw her way out of the well. Evidence of her single-minded need to kill.

Increases the duration of Projection’s bonus movement speed by 50%.

addons.name: Mother's Comb
addons.description:
The comb Sadako's mother used in the tape. Sadako's psychic abilities are enhanced when she focuses on it.

Turning off a TV will trigger a loud noise notification.Reveals the Aura of any TV that is turned off by any means.

addons.name: VCR
addons.description:
The original VCR that played Sadako's tape. It is still warm to the touch.

All TVs play the Projection effects when The Onryō Projects to a TV.

addons.name: Distorted Photo
addons.description:
Those who have watched the tape find all photos of them distorted, a reminder of their impending doom.

Survivors witnessing a Manifestation from within 16 meters will scream, and then their auras are shown for 4 seconds.

addons.name: Telephone
addons.description:
After watching the video, victims receive a phone call. They are frozen in fear as they realize they have seven days to live.

Manifestation afflicts Survivors within 7 meters with a 3% Hindered status effect for 3 seconds.

Hindered reduces survivor movement speed.

addons.name: Tape Editing Deck
addons.description:
The editing deck used by Reiko and Ryuji to analyze and copy the tape. Copying and sharing the tape is the only way to survive the curse.

Each Survivor starts the trial with a Tape in their possession, and their target TV is the furthest from their location.Anytime a Survivor inserts a tape in their target TV, reveal their aura for 6 seconds

addons.name: Remote Control
addons.description:
A remote for the VCR at the cabin. It allows Sadako to focus on those enemies at a distance.

After using Projection, the Auras of Survivors who are within 12 meters of a powered TV are revealed to you for 7 seconds.

addons.name: Iridescent Videotape
addons.description:
The original tape containing Sadako’s curse.

Projection does not turn off TVs, and does not apply Condemned.Increases the time it takes for a TV to turn on after being turned off by Survivors by 20%

addons.name: Scraps
addons.description:
Springs, screws and gears. Mostly unusable junk.

Adds 8 charges to the Toolbox.

addons.name: Wire Spool
addons.description:
A portable but heavy spool of copper wire.

Adds 12 charges to the Toolbox.

addons.name: Clean Rag
addons.description:
A mundane rag. Suspiciously clean.

Increases the Toolbox's repair speed by 20%.

addons.name: Grip Wrench
addons.description:
An adjustable wrench with a tough grip. Essential in any Toolbox.

Hooks sabotaged using the Toolbox take an extra 20 seconds to respawn.

addons.name: Hacksaw
addons.description:
A small hand saw mounted with a metal cutting blade.

Increases the Toolbox's sabotage speed by 30%.

addons.name: Protective Gloves
addons.description:
Thick gloves which reduce manual dexterity but protect hands from injury.

Prevents the Killer from being notified when sabotaging a hook with the Toolbox.

addons.name: Brand New Part
addons.description:
This intricate mechanical part feels oddly out of place. It is clean and shiny as if straight out of the factory.

Toolbox Repair action is replaced with Install Brand New Part.During the installation, you will be faced with a difficult Skill Check.Upon succeeding the Skill Check, the generator's required charges are reduced by 10.This add-on is consumed after use.

addons.name: Instructions
addons.description:
Someone quickly painted what seems to be repair instructions on this piece of bark.

Eliminates Skill Checks while repairing with the Toolbox.

addons.name: Cutting Wire
addons.description:
A rudimentary cutting tool made from a jagged metal wire and two wooden handles.

Increases the Toolbox's sabotage speed by 20%.

addons.name: Socket Swivels
addons.description:
Swivels provide bend and flexibility for bolts that are out of reach, deep within mechanical devices.

Increases the Toolbox repair speed by 30%.

addons.name: Spring Clamp
addons.description:
Useful tool to clamp hoses or hold wires in place and prevent damage or injury.

The distance at which your repairs can be heard is reduced by 8 meters.

addons.name: Black Strap
addons.description: A nylon strap that was used to restrain a victim to a metal frame. The color makes it difficult to see the blood soaked into it.Decreases the range of Punishment of the Damned by 25%.Increases the width of Punishment of the Damned by 25%.

addons.name: Burning Man Painting
addons.description: A diagram of the Lakeview Hotel. Red flames are painted over this place of guilt.When missing Punishment of the Damned, see the auras of Survivors within 3 meters for 6 seconds.

addons.name: Cinderella Music Box
addons.description: A music box with a figure from the fairy tale Cinderella. Found inside a suitcase adorned with stickers from multiple destinations.Decreases Punishment of the Damned's cooldown by 10%.

addons.name: Copper Ring
addons.description: Found in the basement of Brookhaven Hospital. It’s engraved with a picture of a spider.Increases maximum duration of Rites of Judgment by 5 seconds.

addons.name: Crimson Ceremony Book
addons.description:
A book about an ancient god. Author unknown.Survivors damaged by Punishment of the Damned suffer from the Hemorrhage and Mangled status effects for 80 seconds.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until healed.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Dead Butterfly
addons.description: A butterfly found on a bed at Wood Side Apartments. It’s frail and nearly falls apart when touched.Increases Rites of Judgment's recharge rate by 10%.

addons.name: Forgotten Videotape
addons.description: A videotape of two lovers vacationing in Silent Hill. Despite its sentimental value, it was left behind in the Lakeview Hotel.Increases the speed at which Punishment of the Damned travels by 10%.

addons.name: Iridescent Seal of Metatron
addons.description: A talisman with an odd design inscribed on it. The Entity’s influence seems to have altered it.Decreases the range of Punishment of the Damned by 50%.Punishment of the Damned's range increases by creating Rites of Judgment trails, up to a maximum of 200%.This resets when Punishment of the Damned hits a Survivor.

addons.name: Lead Ring
addons.description: Found in a refrigerator. It’s engraved with a disgusting, bloated face.Increases the range of Punishment of the Damned by 25%.Decreases the width of Punishment of the Damned by 25%.

addons.name: Leopard-Print Fabric
addons.description: A shred of pink, leopard print fabric. It’s difficult to tell what it was used for.Decreases the duration of stuns by 15% while using Rites of Judgment.

addons.name: Lost Memories Book
addons.description:
A book about the history and legends of Silent Hill and the surrounding area.Survivors injured by Punishment of the Damned suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 80 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing or being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.

addons.name: Mannequin Foot
addons.description: The smooth grey foot of a mannequin, brutally torn from its leg.Rites of Judgment trails inflict Exhausted for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Misty Day, Remains of Judgment
addons.description: A painting of an imposing figure wearing a steel pyramid atop his head. Victims are caged in the background.Injuring a Survivor with Punishment of the Damned reveals their aura for 8 seconds.

addons.name: Obsidian Goblet
addons.description: An ancient looking goblet carved from pure obsidian.You can special-break Pallets and Breakable walls with Punishment of the Damned.Increases Punishment of the Damned's cooldown by 20%.

addons.name: Rust-colored Egg
addons.description: An old-looking egg, colored reddish orange. About the size of a quail’s egg.Injuring a Survivor with Punishment of the Damned increases Rites of Judgment's charge by 30%.

addons.name: Scarlet Egg
addons.description: A fresh egg, strikingly red in color. About the size of a quail’s egg.Survivors afflicted with Torment spawn Rites of Judgment trails when sprinting. These trails last 5 seconds.You no longer see the auras of Rites of Judgment trails.

addons.name: Spearhead
addons.description: The sharp, rusted tip of a spear. It’s flaked with blood from its last victim.When a Survivor is saved from a Cage of Atonement, you see their rescuer's aura for 8 seconds.

addons.name: Tablet of the Oppressor
addons.description: A metal tablet engraved with Aztec figures.While using Rites of Judgment, gain the Undetectable Status Effect.

addons.name: Valtiel Sect Photograph
addons.description: A photograph of two figures in red hoods. Entitled Crimson and White Banquet for the Gods.Decreases your Terror Radius by 2 meters for each Survivor affected by Torment.

addons.name: Wax Doll
addons.description: A doll carved from wax, handcrafted by a prisoner who would soon face their judgment.Increases the range of Punishment of the Damned by 5%.

addons.name: Bloody Coil
addons.description:
Part sticky, part slippery, this grim liquid makes handling the traps' springs more dangerous.

When a Bear Trap is disarmed by a healthy Survivor, the bloody coils exact their price and that Survivor becomes injured.

addons.name: Iridescent Stone
addons.description:
Traps sharpened with this sickly gleaming stone seem to gain a life of their own.

Every 30 seconds, one closed Bear Trap chosen at random becomes set.

addons.name: Oily Coil
addons.description:
An oiled spring that marks the hands of those who meddle with a Bear Trap.

When resetting a Bear Trap, reveal the aura of the most recent Survivor to disarm it for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Rusted Jaws
addons.description:
These Bear Trap jaws are covered with crusty and volatile rust spots that makes injuries particularly difficult to heal.

Bear Traps inflict Mangled on trapped survivors for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

addons.name: Tension Spring
addons.description:
A high tension spring that snaps back into place after being stretched.

A Bear Trap resets 2 seconds after a Survivor escapes from it.

addons.name: Coffee Grounds
addons.description:
An old rusted can containing damp coffee grounds.

Increases the Haste status effect gained after setting a  Bear Trap by 5%.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.

addons.name: Memento Blades
addons.description:
Blood-rusted knives, worn from overuse. Employed during Ji-woon's early murders, they hold a place of importance in his heart.

Displays a reticle while aiming with Blades.

addons.name: Trick Pouch
addons.description:
A pouch with a number of hidden pockets. Used by aspiring magicians and those with something to hide.

Increases maximum carried Blades by 8.Start the Trial with 8 additional Blades.

addons.name: Killing Part Chords
addons.description:
A set of chords that Ji-woon never found a song for. Still, the sound is undeniably catchy.

Increases time before Style Ranks from D to A decay by 50%.

addons.name: Inferno Wires
addons.description:
Burnt wires from the studio fire that killed four of the five NO SPIN members. Their deaths gave rise to The Trickster.

Increases the Style Rank timer of S-Rank by 20%.

addons.name: Ji-woon's Autograph
addons.description:
A signature from the celebrity known as The Trickster. Sore as his wrist was after hundreds of these, it was invigorating to know he was so in demand.

Increases the duration of Main Event by 44%.

addons.name: On Target Single
addons.description:
An underground single produced by Ji-woon before achieving fame. Only the biggest NO SPIN fans collected this hidden gem.

Increases the duration of Main Event by 0.5 seconds for each Blade hit while in S-Rank, up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

addons.name: Lucky Blade
addons.description:
The first throwing knife Ji-woon ever owned. Purchased by his father, he was expected to put on a show for those frequenting the family restaurant.

On every eighth Blade Hit, an additional bonus is assigned at random:

Increases Throw Speed by 5% for 5 seconds.Gain 3% Haste for 6 seconds.Gain an additional Style Point.

addons.name: Caged Heart Shoes
addons.description:
Shoes that Ji-woon wore during the music video for One Caged Heart. Allows for smooth, graceful movements of the point dance.

When you basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls or damage Generators, the next time you enter the Throw State, increase movement speed while in the Throw State by 5% for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Tequila Moonrock
addons.description:
A drink invented in a modest Changwon bar. Became a favorite of Ji-woon's.

Increases Throw Speed by 8% for 10 seconds after gaining a Style Rank.

addons.name: Bloody Boa
addons.description:
A boa that Ji-woon draped around a victim’s slashed neck. A number of pockets are concealed within it.

Decreases the speed at which Laceration decays by 75%.

addons.name: Fizz-Spin Soda
addons.description:
A limited edition can of soda promoting NO SPIN. High sugar and caffeine content.

Decreases the number of Blade Throws required to increase Throw Speed by 2.

addons.name: Waiting for You Watch
addons.description:
A pocket watch worn by Ji-woon during a live performance of I’ll Be Waiting for You. It’s a stage prop that doesn’t work and never will.

Survivors whose Laceration Meter fully decays are revealed for 10 seconds.

addons.name: Ripper Brace
addons.description:
A wrist brace worn by Ji-woon during the filming of his music video Ripper. Though unintentional, the design stabilizes the wrist better than many medical braces.

For each Style Rank, you basic-vault Windows, basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, and damage Generators 6% faster.

addons.name: Melodious Murder
addons.description:
An audio file of victims’ crisp, clear shrieks. Ji-woon incorporated the sounds into one of his more popular tracks.

Increases Blade reload speed at lockers by 25%.

addons.name: Diamond Cufflinks
addons.description:
Cufflinks gouged into the eyes of a sasaeng fan who made the mistake of stalking Ji-woon. Rubbing off the blood, there’s so much to be seen in the glitter.

Reveals Survivor auras for 6 seconds when their Laceration reaches one Blade hit from maximum.

addons.name: Edge of Revival Album
addons.description:
The Trickster’s debut album. The coarse and vicious tone was met with a mixed reaction from fans despite critical acclaim.

Blade Hits from more than 20 meters away deal 100% more Laceration.

addons.name: Trick Blades
addons.description:
Specialty blades that are only seen as faulty by those who lack imagination. A young Ji-woon dazzled spectators with the tricks he performed.

Blades can ricochet off of the environment once.On every eighth Blade Hit after a ricochet, an additional bonus is assigned at random:Increases Laceration by 100%.Reveal Survivor auras within 12 meters for 4.4 seconds.Gain an additional Style Point.

addons.name: Cut Thru U Single
addons.description:
The first single released by NO SPIN after Ji-woon joined their ranks. Scored an all-kill on the Korean charts.

When reaching A-Rank, Survivors within 32 meters are revealed with Killer Instinct for 4.4 seconds.

addons.name: Death Throes Compilation
addons.description:
A collection of the final sounds from Ji-woon's victims, adapted to a vinyl record. Terrifying and emotionally raw.

Refills Blades by 75% of the maximum when Main Event ends.

addons.name: Iridescent Photocard
addons.description:
A glass-like photo molded from The Fog itself. Ji-woon's eyes shimmer holographically on his grinning face.

Increases the duration of Main Event by 100%.When Main Event is activated: reveal your aura to all Survivors, all Survivors’ auras are revealed, and block all Generators for 6 seconds.
